Peter, Let’s rewind a couple of years to the Summer of 2020.
In Blue states like Wisconsin, Democratic Governors like Tony Evers were busy locking
people down and shutting down businesses, all while letting rioters burn their cities. **But not Florida.** We drew a line in the sand and stood up for freedom. Their freedom to make a living,
send kids to school, see loved ones, and live in freedom.
And because of that, **Florida became the beacon of freedom for the rest of the
country**— _even ‘Lockdown Liberals’ came to Florida to enjoy our freedom._
While ‘the free state of Florida’ is unique, the rights we cherish and protect aren’t.
They are spelled out clearly in the Constitution for every American.

**All it takes is a leader willing to defend it. And that’s exactly what Tim Michels will
do as Governor of Wisconsin.**

Tim Michels will be your last line of defense against Joe Biden and an out-of-control
federal government.
Like me, Tim served his country, and swore an oath to defend the Constitution and our
liberties. An oath he kept in his 12 years of service in the US Army...and one I know he

clean_body: How WE can help Wisconsin| | | Please see a note from our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this . Peter, Let’s rewind a couple of years to the Summer of 2020. In Blue states like Wisconsin, Democratic Governors like Tony Evers were busy locking people down and shutting down businesses, all while letting rioters burn their cities. But not Florida. We drew a line in the sand and stood up for freedom. Their freedom to make a living, send kids to school, see loved ones, and live in freedom. And because of that, Florida became the beacon of freedom for the rest of the country— even ‘Lockdown Liberals’ came to Florida to enjoy our freedom. While ‘the free state of Florida’ is unique, the rights we cherish and protect aren’t. They are spelled out clearly in the Constitution for every American. All it takes is a leader willing to defend it. And that’s exactly what Tim Michels will do as Governor of Wisconsin. Tim Michels will be your last line of defense against Joe Biden and an out-of-control federal government. Like me, Tim served his country, and swore an oath to defend the Constitution and our liberties. An oath he kept in his 12 years of service in the US Army...and one I know he will protect as your next Governor. Tim will make defending the freedom of Wisconsinites his #1 priority as governor. body:
A stunning victory for Brazil’s left.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221031-3555-header&t=1&akid=3555%2E2526796%2EApbHrz)
Did you hear the news?!
The results of Brazil’s presidential runoff election have been announced, and it’s official: **Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has defeated far-right incumbent Jair Bolsonaro with more than 60 million votes, the most in Brazil’s history.**
This is a stunning victory for the global fight against facism.
Bolsonaro had received an endorsement from President Trump. His time in office was marked by militarization, deforestation, violence towards indigenous populations, and a bigoted and racist rhetoric.1
Lula da Silva previously served two terms as President between 2003 - 2010. During this time, he expanded innovative social programs such as the Bolsa Familia, which provided direct cash transfers to low-income families, allowing and incentivizing parents to send their children to school rather than to work.2 Bolsa Familia soon became the largest reaching conditional cash transfer program in the world, estimated to have benefitted 11.1 million families (46 million people!).3 **Lula plans to improve and expand upon such social programs in his new term.**
Lula’s upcoming term in office holds promises for the environment. Brazil is home to just over 60 percent of the Amazon rainforest. Under Bolsonaro’s presidency, primary forest loss in Brazil skyrocketed — losing more than 8.4 million acres from August 2019 - July 20214, and accounting for over 40 percent of global forest loss in 20215. **Lula da Silva’s commitment to curbing deforestation and nurturing Brazil’s biodiversity could be a model for global climate leadership working to constrain climate change.**
Here in the U.S., we can learn a lot from this intervention on authoritarianism: the Brazilian people set a mandate for better conditions for workers, their families, and for the environment. **Lula’s victory — as well as recent wins for progressive politicians in Chile, Argentina, and Colombia — gives us hope that the left can, and will, respond to this alarming rightward trend in global politics.**

Lincon Zarbietti/picture-alliance/dpa/AP Images

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek,

It’s Stacey Abrams here with one final message this month.

If the past year of campaigning has taught me anything, it’s that more is
possible for Georgia. And I genuinely believe that progress only happens
when we all show up and fight for it.

With early vote underway, Election Day next week and our final
end-of-month deadline of this campaign at midnight tonight, I’m counting
on each and every one of us to show up for Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221031_B5_SYALastTime_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=16475%2E1862389%2E5Jj20m ]So, I’m humbly asking for the last time in October: will you help me
fight for a better future for Georgia before it’s too late? Your
$5 donation could tilt the scale towards making history in
a race this close,
Derek. Chip in what you can
before our midnight deadline:

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221031_B5_SYALastTime_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=16475%2E1862389%2E5Jj20m ]DONATE

I have seen a lot of hope and joy on the road these last 11 months. From
Albany to Augusta and everywhere in between, folks have gone from debating
whether they’ll vote at all to excitedly telling me they proudly voted
early.

So much is at stake here in Georgia. But I know with your help we can
reach out to Georgians who’ve been let down by our system and fight
alongside them. And I will fight alongside Georgians every step of the
way, meet them where they are and most of all — make sure their voices are
heard.

But I need the resources to fight for them.

That’s why I’m reaching out to you one final time before tonight’s
end-of-month deadline,
Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221031_B5_SYALastTime_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=16475%2E1862389%2E5Jj20m ]With just a few short days left until the final ballot is cast in Early
Vote, will you show the world that Georgia is worth fighting for? Let’s
show everyone — Brian Kemp, the media and everyone else who counted us out
— that we have a mandate for progress here in Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221031_B5_SYALastTime_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=16475%2E1862389%2E5Jj20m ]DONATE

— Stacey Abrams

name: Vernon Robinson
subject: Beasley Scares me-Scare her back
body:
| Peter \--

Cheri Beasley is indeed scary. She supports the failing policies of the Biden Harris administration including those driving costs of everything through the roof and supporting abortion up to birth. Her election to the Senate from North Carolina would continue our descent into the abyss of socialism. She should scare you too. But don't be scared. Scare her back! | [](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boo&n=1 "Scare her back") [Scare her back](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boo&n=1)
---
I want to update you on where the effort to win black voter support for the Trump endorsed Republican nominee, Ted Budd, stands. We have run radio ads for four weeks.
These ads contrasted Budd and the Republican team's position on Life, educational opportunity, jobs and wealth creation, securing the border, public safety and inflation with Beasley's far left ridiculousness.
For those of you who haven't heard, the failure of the GOP to communicate with black voters directly and ask for support for the last 56 years has done great damage to our country. Democrats don't even have to debate issues like Life and school choice.
They just run terrorist ads that can be summed up with **_Vote Democrat because Republicans want to kill your mama and your dog._**
It is so bad that most black voters believe that positive policies come Democrats and negative ones from Republicans. So when asked which party will defend the innocent unborn, 65% of black Democrats answered Democrat. It almost as bad with school choice, cutting taxes, defending the border and keeping 2nd Amendment rights.
Since 2002, we've known that urban contemporary radio can be used to effectively communicate directly with black voters, contrast the success of GOP policies with the disaster of Democrat ones and reach black voters 35+ to ask for their support of the Republican team.
That's why I'm asking you to donate. I'm not sending you five emails a day with some gimmick or tell you the sky is falling. I'm just informing you that asking black voters for support makes a lot more sense than trying to find the mythical marginal white voter.
We have radio ads up on the urban contemporary radio along the I-85 corridor where this race will be decided and I need to raise $5,500 dollars to complete this campaign's last week of radio.
The Trafalgar Group says this race is going to the wire.
[Urban contemporary radio bringing hard hitting high contrast ads like this one we are running in Georgia](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/r?u=GKqXKoxzHTBdlHADEQBsXvdg4yiQO9EUo4JKSQNr8dNIhizbWj2cLvCa9zBvOBHwVcww3MmBcgHMmF-IrYoOHw&e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boo&n=2), can kick a field goal and win this close swing state. It is the most effective way to move voters at this point at the end of the election.
If you are able to give five or six figures please call me at 336 577-2711. If you can give any amount to continue on the offensive and keep the inflation ad on the air, please donate today.
We've watched terrorist loot and burn cities, Democrats cheer them on and too many Republicans cower under their desks.
Don't get mad, get even and hit them where is hurts. Every time this radio campaign has been run black support for Democrats and turnout go down. `Please give $0 ``or whatever you can.`
[Please Donate Today](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boo&n=3)
At this point in the campaign season none of your donation on-line goes to overhead or personnel, it goes to radio ads. We need that $5,000.
Remember Black Americans Making America First is a hybrid political committee which means we can accept a donation of any amount if you are not a foreign national or government contractor. And we can accept corporate contributions as well.
Thank you for doing the hard work of freedom.
Vernon Robinson, Treasurer, Black Americans Making America First
P.S. Booooo.

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I know it's late, but this is important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
#
Friends:
As we are quickly approaching our final end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight, I am writing to you one last time before October ends with an important request.
Today has been a great day for our campaign. Lots and lots of people are contributing to help reach our goals. That support means the world to me.
But my team just re-ran the numbers, and we are still a bit short of where we need to be in order to reach our goals by midnight.
So with only a few hours to go, I am asking you if you can make a contribution, one that is of a larger amount than we typically ask of you.
Friend — can I count on you to make a $10 contribution tonight before the final monthly deadline of this campaign? Please use this link to make your contribution:
[**https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/October-31**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221031-5-gm-full8&t=1&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0)
I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t important. But the truth is, unless I can count on our top supporters tonight, we risk needing to cut critical voter outreach programs just days before Election Day.
So we cannot lose sight. I am very grateful for everyone who has pitched in today, and I know that with your support, we can have a big night and close this gap. Let's do this!
Mandela Barnes
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221031-5-gm-full8&t=2&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0)

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=3&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0). Mandela is counting on people like you to fund this campaign. [**Make a contribution to stand with Mandela today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mandela-em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=5&refcode2=3907_196590_jXJF-0&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0)
Submit this form to [**update your contact information.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/update-contact-info/?source=em-footer&t=6&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0)
Be sure to [**visit our campaign store**](https://store.mandelabarnes.com/?t=7&akid=3907%2E196590%2EjXJF-0) to check out all of the latest Mandela merchandise.
To receive important updates from our campaign, text JOIN to 99749 or [**if you're on a mobile device, follow this link to opt in to text updates.**](https://mandela.afy.ai/GaB1F)
[](https://mandela.afy.ai/GaB1F)
By providing your cell phone number you consent to receive recurring text message updates from Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin, including by automated text message. Text HELP for help, STOP to end. Message and data rates may apply. [Privacy Policy](https://mandelabarnes.com/privacy-policy) and [Terms of Service](https://mandelabarnes.com/terms-of-service).

body:
New telephone campaign shows us winning swing voters. | | | |
---
| | |
## Surge in Democratic and Unaffiliated Support for Cox/Schifanelli! - 66% of Democrats and Unaffiliated Voters Called Choose Dan Cox
Friends, After a year and half of non-stop work, we are just seven days and a wake up from Election Day. Your immediate future freedom in Maryland depends on November 8. Lower taxes and inflation, safe streets, world class education without indoctrination, and in fact the principles in our treasured Bill of Rights, are all on the ballot.

As American hero Ronald Reagan said in 1964, this is our Time for Choosing because if we lose freedom here, there is no other place to escape to on earth.

And as my personal friend and American hero, President Trump said in his [famous and inspiring speech on July 3rd, 2020 at Mt. Rushmore](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=021a3d7e8f&e=5bb5efcda7), "there is a growing danger that threatens every blessing our ancestors fought so hard for, struggled, and bled to secure. Our nation is witnessing a merciless campaign to wipe out our history, defame our heroes, erase our values, and indoctrinate our children ...My fellow Americans, it is time to speak up loudly and strongly and powerfully and defend the integrity of our country."

Last night I was provided new data from our political consulting firm showing a surge in swing voters choosing Dan Cox for Governor.

According to our major professional telephone campaign personally reaching 61,000 likely voters on a live call and asking if they plan to vote for Dan Cox for Governor, 66% of Democrat and Unaffiliated voters who were asked this question answered "yes, Dan Cox". According to this firm and as I've personally noticed on the campaign trail, swing voters are breaking our way in a major shift. We need to reach the estimated 11% undecideds this week.

_What we need immediately:_

1\. _**We are $50,000 short**_ of our goal for our GOTV (Get Out the Vote) effort with **texting and media invoices** needing to be paid TOMORROW. Please make [a donation](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=07bf636d4a&e=5bb5efcda7) tonight to help us if you can do so.

2\. We need volunteers at the polls every day! Democrat volunteers are showing up to the early voting polls, but Republicans are not at the same level of coverage it appears. For example, Randallstown had eight Democrat teacher's union volunteers and Republicans had none; Odenton, similar; Thurmont, same. This seems to be a state-wide issue. **We need you!** Contact Crystal Jenkins or Dan Hall ([dan@dancoxforgovernor.com](mailto:dan@dancoxforgovernor.com)) to schedule your time at a poll and bring your friends to help.

3\. We still need calling from the APP for our GOTV effort. Please sign up for that as well.

Thank you for your labors of love for our country and state. Let's win!

Freedom,

Dan Cox

P.S. I hope you enjoy these two inspiring speeches below from President Trump and President Reagan. The principles they cite are just as current in this week's election and if anything, even more urgent.

| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772471:JiokEsGtN:m:1:3317145305:B6A8B3C225C7D5B06056D7611941E283:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772471:JiokEsGtN:m:1:3317145305:B6A8B3C225C7D5B06056D7611941E283:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772471:JiokEsGtN:m:1:3317145305:B6A8B3C225C7D5B06056D7611941E283:r "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772471:JiokEsGtN:m:1:3317145305:B6A8B3C225C7D5B06056D7611941E283:r "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

CAMPAIGN")

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt
_Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Nevada_

| | | Peter,

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772483:Jp_AEsGtN:m:1:3331421248:C7BBDF4E63B0D699530B278439D253A4:r "Now, my mission
continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772483:Jp_AEsGtN:m:1:3331421248:C7BBDF4E63B0D699530B278439D253A4:r "Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772483:Jp_AEsGtN:m:1:3331421248:C7BBDF4E63B0D699530B278439D253A4:r "A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite. I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office. "Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. " He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. "Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?" Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms. Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people. If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me. "A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures ➡
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61772469:6rrbEsGNb:m:1:3253819041:CF059B78C06FD100A776416EE2DAAD0E:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5mhi718i26ka3qed0ppgg8tev2c115819bish30_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9ie6o77cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8or0c1gj8d5hmjpqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65thn69om3cpmccqj0tjhmpoecs74s1o7dcbgsip3co75ceq7cttmctie0p9l6dgefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32cllm5g7epj66phbbdhnm2qmash5u)
This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1ed0pd0hu8p58np7avvqvjglsp9esj61lscdgi8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9ie6o77cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr5m2f2hk3o6ggckji345m4tchuc5p84nadetf20_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9ie6o77cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ziq737pjf9fhna2t9a0egfeode0iq3lp0p0he3fo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9ie6o77cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!

name: Macky Stafford
subject: Call to Action
body:
Flood the polls, Maryland!
|
---
This is a national Call to Action that is being implemented in Maryland. The attorneys that are working on the voter fraud issue across the nation have given us two safeguards that must be implemented in order for there to be any chance of fighting inconsistencies in vote counts after the election. Please spread this information as rapidly as possible. It is crucial in saving our freedom: #1) One day voting: All Marylanders must vote in person, one day only, on November 8th. Absolutely no early voting and no mail in ballots. #2) Paper ballots: While at the polls on November 8th, request a paper ballot – NO touch screen voting. If paper ballot is not provided, ask for it. If it is denied, see an election official. Demand paper. No touch screen voting. The attorneys working on this have told us that for any hope of reconciling vote counts – regardless of party affiliation – all Marylanders must use these two safeguards. This information may be common sense to you, but it’s not to many of your friends and family, especially the elderly. Spread these instructions far & wide. Take a different approach this election and anticipate waiting in what are hopefully the longest lines in Maryland history. And be grateful that you are. While you are waiting in line, talk to fellow voters about using paper as opposed to touch screens. Get ready to stand in line, Maryland! Stand up for your rights, stand up for voter integrity, stand up for freedom. Flood the polls, Maryland!

clean_body: Flood the polls, Maryland! | This is a national Call to Action that is being implemented in Maryland. The attorneys that are working on the voter fraud issue across the nation have given us two safeguards that must be implemented in order for there to be any chance of fighting inconsistencies in vote counts after the election. Please spread this information as rapidly as possible. It is crucial in saving our freedom: #1) One day voting: All Marylanders must vote in person, one day only, on November 8th. Absolutely no early voting and no mail in ballots. #2) Paper ballots: While at the polls on November 8th, request a paper ballot – NO touch screen voting. If paper ballot is not provided, ask for it. If it is denied, see an election official. Demand paper. No touch screen voting. The attorneys working on this have told us that for any hope of reconciling vote counts – regardless of party affiliation – all Marylanders must use these two safeguards. This information may be common sense to you, but it’s not to many of your friends and family, especially the elderly. Spread these instructions far & wide. Take a different approach this election and anticipate waiting in what are hopefully the longest lines in Maryland history. And be grateful that you are. While you are waiting in line, talk to fellow voters about using paper as opposed to touch screens. Get ready to stand in line, Maryland! Stand up for your rights, stand up for voter integrity, stand up for freedom. Flood the polls, Maryland! Macky Stafford Campaign Coordinator, Peroutka for Attorney General, State of Maryland 410-336-9894 | | | | | | Patriots 4 Peroutka, 151 Longfellow Drive, Millersville, MD 21108

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re lo
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2ppo18nuas6apdjfndlt1ju0u6gc9jha704t110_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpg60pb0sph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp2r9j9fs5phs63i4tns887t133gf6kv1hao2nq8_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpg60pb0sph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “The Second World Wars ” on DVD: Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! the most important message you will read today

|
| | | Friend,

Hi, I’m former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today’s Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80719%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fH9l5hO6B8%2f78Qvk4YITw&sysid=1 "Now, my mission continues:
working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting
my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80710%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ggD7w5lRx2lVWAybM6bP6g&sysid=1 "Can you chip in $10, $25,
$50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let’s remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can’t stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80711%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pvKAf7n2CYl2jBwBUZqNGA&sysid=1 "A donation of $10, $25,

body:

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq2orutd5qd3f8o7qpfes6b6fr1jsb1ca9bd272g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpg64oj4cph2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in – by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zggub9s208614d50jed8redgbn5eu14qn0sv000g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpg64oj4cph2bs) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6444%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=XvRfCsH0hPEnGFTmmPX0OA&sysid=1)

| | Dear Friend, There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It’s a narrative that you’ll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered “correct” by the “right” people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That’s why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77851%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aKU%2fhxB0mz4MpGiJRjWrPg&sysid=1)**

---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you’ll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77853%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zu2bpUree4Muufak9UsCZg&sysid=1)**

| Dear Friends,
We are one week away from the most important election in our lifetime. We have made our message loud and clear to voters. We have crafted advertising around our message thanks to your generous support. We believe our message is resonating with voters.
Now we are left to GET OUT THE VOTE. Those efforts must be coordinated and deliberate. To accomplish all that we did we must finish the job and get our voters to the polls.
Can we count on your help to fund our GOTV efforts? The district is big and the task at hand is expensive. But we cannot let that stop us. Friends –
I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact _all_ Americans. Next week, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just one week left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.

name: Herschel Walker
subject: The time is now ⏰
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
I've fallen behind!
| |
---
| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised over $26 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775394:JBkkvsGSN:m:1:3374627611:4E4713C3FEC4D19F314E13C644E766D9:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775394:JBkkvsGSN:m:1:3374627611:4E4713C3FEC4D19F314E13C644E766D9:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775394:JBkkvsGSN:m:1:3374627611:4E4713C3FEC4D19F314E13C644E766D9:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.**

Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.**

But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.**

**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!**

If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.” **

That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.**

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.**

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch

body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d64732dc9a7245d9a0efb0dcebbb0e36&_e=37UiFupDLO1aDekm_WCmjaJR0ppbS2k_wfeR6h-D5uIeyBtbzSyMvdHhEFuE3t3mCbbP0ZBTEo2lqMqtZfxoK2BeyW1qdyzu_XRBeFJzdl9GclIEbyPsS4T09TFSRx6ZHX8YPbmx4qdQZZHQQCpWls5WiRQkdjVnf-0giFGJkWRmzZCYC_-gJT-baRac_CXdi2QWHey6fhOskcZfFt5F6IERdvqllUH1iB4PXhQlBjXr_QTN3DTLFg8_J_2oUSue2_5iak8fR3-KPX0h-6TWiCqGWQYVQE-7_E5iuyeYqwvFpj4ucd4_B3c5Lbpka8BgKmfwYMPuMWX-SpLCyA5JjD3Iz1z4se8c932JlIjHxvooUdwj-atG5x0fwPEVhErG0oP46-SVSrWxwIb86JGftw%3D%3D) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d64732dc9a7245d9a0efb0dcebbb0e36&_e=37UiFupDLO1aDekm_WCmjaJR0ppbS2k_wfeR6h-D5uIeyBtbzSyMvdHhEFuE3t3mCbbP0ZBTEo2lqMqtZfxoK2BeyW1qdyzu_XRBeFJzdl9GclIEbyPsS4T09TFSRx6ZHX8YPbmx4qdQZZHQQCpWls5WiRQkdjVnf-0giFGJkWRmzZCYC_-gJT-baRac_CXdi2QWHey6fhOskcZfFt5F6IERdvqllUH1iB4PXhQlBjXr_QTN3DTLFg8_J_2oUSue0CCLAHLMcsHxxULIKJ3Bc-C65YUfmzojlM5R2MPVfWlZAI5pesw0fHab6lVcCcREMpRadhAeL1_sK2OaNwtkZQzNeti7bs_V3hF-WGhPlgR2V4hG2LMmTQPWRXE1ZPHc-fUVKly_iGCnHOTnEnpHAA%3D%3D) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d64732dc9a7245d9a0efb0dcebbb0e36&_e=37UiFupDLO1aDekm_WCmjaJR0ppbS2k_wfeR6h-D5uIeyBtbzSyMvdHhEFuE3t3mCbbP0ZBTEo2lqMqtZfxoK2BeyW1qdyzu_XRBeFJzdl9GclIEbyPsS4T09TFSRx6ZHX8YPbmx4qdQZZHQQCpWls5WiRQkdjVnf-0giFGJkWRmzZCYC_-gJT-baRac_CXdi2QWHey6fhOskcZfFt5F6IERdvqllUH1iB4PXhQlBjXr_QTN3DTLFg8_J_2oUSueOBMs2U84FhRtsiI0OZTRmvDF5o1RgdTg5ZcLpil_S73_JBXbSQXp5YDFE4_web4tgN-F5RIGOQf0_a40D3DBxs-on4FIj7B-4TMf3Sh_hkIrVmdTsLNI-Ye486C_9E2S4HqPA6Gf78p6FrdTsR0zpg%3D%3D) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. The United States faces many threats, but some of them, because of their hidden nature, are even more sinister. One of these hidden threats is the way that China and Big Tech have, for years, exploited our weakened patent protection laws. They do it for power and money, and it threatens everything from our national security to the ability of individual Americans to achieve their dreams. **Our latest documentary,**[**Innovation Race,**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIzMDUtYTc4MDQ1M2FhMjQxNDQwYjg4NTNiZjY2YjIzNDFhZTYiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmlubm92YXRpb25yYWNlbW92aWUuY29tL3NjcmVlbmluZ3M_bWlkPTQ2MDEyJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/f_k_rHy0iF3C1g3Me_P5PA)**explores this little-discussed threat, and I am so excited to invite you the nationwide theatrical release on Wednesday, November 16th!** The following cities are holding screenings on one night only at 7:30pm local time: _Chicago, Cincinnati, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, Orlando, Phoenix/Mesa, Pittsburgh, San Francisco, Seattle, Tampa, and Washington, DC._ Watch the [**trailer**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-vYQ)**,** and then [**get your tickets**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIzMDUtYTc4MDQ1M2FhMjQxNDQwYjg4NTNiZjY2YjIzNDFhZTYiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmlubm92YXRpb25yYWNlbW92aWUuY29tL3NjcmVlbmluZ3M_bWlkPTQ2MDEyJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/XLXmlbafDKQq_fIufiLPFg) right away if you’re near a screening! Big Tech and China would love nothing more than for this issue to disappear. Their success depends on Americans not knowing about it, not talking about, and not working to stop them. Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I'm being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

I don't want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday's fundraising totals shocked me to the core. Dear Peter,
This summer, Democrats in Congress delivered the single largest investment in climate solutions and environmental justice in the history of our nation.

It’s the same story in Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District. Only one candidate is pledging to move our nation toward a more sustainable future and that’s Senator Heidi Campbell.

It’s amazing what a difference Congress can make, but it won’t happen without our support.
Vote for climate action. Vote for Heidi Campbell.
Thanks,
Al Gore

He doesn’t like to use the word “proud” often, but I could tell, on that night, he was proud. He told me _all_ about what that bill would do to fight the climate crisis. He felt it was one of the most important things he could do for our future — not just for me and my sisters, but for every Coloradan growing up today. That’s just how my dad has been as long as I can remember. **He truly, deeply cares about every single kid he represents. He fights for ALL Colorado families the same way he fights for his own.**

* * *
When I was little, we spent family weekends on long drives traversing the Rocky Mountains, meeting with constituents. My mom, my two younger sisters, and I viewed Coloradans as my dad’s bosses. It was our job to listen and to fight for them.
Then, one night when I was a little bit older, Dad sat us all down and asked how we’d feel if he ran for president. Anne, Halina, and I didn’t think twice; we were all in. Mom was a bit more cautious, but ultimately she turned to us and said “this feels like something good that we can do for you all and for your generation.”
My dad didn’t win that race, but he did what he felt was right. He built that campaign around the _Child Tax Credit_ — traveling the country talking about how we could cut child poverty. Last year, he did just that and kept nearly 4 million kids nationwide out of poverty. And if he wins re-election, he’ll keep up his fight to make the _Child Tax Credit_ permanent and end child poverty forever.
And that’s why I’m so grateful to have Michael Bennet as my father and Colorado’s senior Senator. He loves his family. He loves Colorado. And he will always do what’s right — no matter how hard.
**So I am asking: Can you please chip in to re-elect my dad and keep him fighting for Colorado? We only have a week left in this race, and he can't do this without us.**

_There is one week until Election Day_. This is the _final_ request I'll make of you to help us raise funds. Matt Birk and I have been so humbled by your generous support. In this final week, we still need to [raise $100,000 more](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=9d463b395f&e=33b11688c1) to get out the vote and ensure we get a win!

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8733e204ca7f4ca1a32c980e061c1753&_e=RBuw-h9l1mvLlNh-ml9t1x5hXMINCdeQ5a9tITvqK0ixyRRDB1jB6zI-Zq_Cru-Uke2UXX-4Is1KWfAeqyPPD1id9eNCQyimYxpjRo-pK6hRphD_lAUR4P-2XJRpxX8Y9kVpH5txTT1A-IpO7Rw2RDQv1XKDhCic5ovS4_GOr9C4-FeyLhMYWJYfwL3C_PFXdc_An9ZaIsFvHQggByTmWWjK1LepfeK-GRHrhTPH52kYuNxI48FMCbhQcvmMooPSt1HHobO9Txx8qX3-70cR8uHGQmrOVe34albfNj8dSA6PFD25c7mkgLE63a7Byk92SkI7hU80laoBuM-r_Fn7IC_Yj-ZkK4rq18fvMbVZhqqnBVhYozWZLgURy9XMR23l2YCyQR8150mLo9MtqEATdQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. body:

---
Derek -- I practiced law for over 30 years. As a lawyer, I can tell you there’s nothing more important than having concrete evidence to support your claim. The kind of evidence that helps establish your claim as a fundamental _truth_. **So, here’s my claim:** If we defend and expand our Democratic congressional majorities next Tuesday, we can continue building a better America. An America where women’s rights are protected, where communities nationwide are supported, and where people have access to quality, affordable health care. **The evidence:** President Biden and Vice President Harris have _already_ secured generational progress on some of the most pressing issues facing the American people. They:
* Helped create over 10 million new jobs since taking office;
* Took the most significant steps to address gun violence in America in decades;
* Took aggressive action to combat climate change;

Virginia Democratic delegate Elizabeth Guzman is bringing a new level of insanity to how public schools treat parents.

**Guzman wants to expand the definition of child abuse to include _" a parent not honoring a child's request to treat them as the opposite sex."_**

name: John Fetterman
subject: Let’s talk about my tattoos.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
“Stupid little fake tattoos”
#
Derek,
Last month, Tucker Carlson went on a nearly 20-minute-long rant about me. The whole thing was as unhinged as you’d expect, but one line that stood out was about my tattoos.
**“All your stupid little fake tattoos,” he said, calling them a “costume.”**
**[In a moment, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 or more to my grassroots campaign. But first, let’s talk about those tattoos Tucker seems to be so interested in.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-1?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221101-7984&refcode2=7984_434096_FpgTl0&akid=7984%2E434096%2EFpgTl0)**
**[Add A Donation Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-1?refcode=em20221101-7984&refcode2=7984_434096_FpgTl0&akid=7984%2E434096%2EFpgTl0)**
I have nine dates tattooed on my right forearm. Each one is a day on which someone died violently in Braddock, Pennsylvania, while I was mayor. **Gun violence and violent crime might be jokes to someone like Tucker, but they are very real to people in towns like Braddock.**
The first one that I tattooed on my arm is “01.16.06.” That’s the date on which Christopher Williams was shot dead while delivering pizzas. This was a man about my age at the time. He had a 12-year-old daughter. I just couldn’t get over the fact that he was never going home to her.
Another tattoo reads “02.03.07,” the date that 23-month-old Nyia Page was found dead after her father sexually assaulted her and left her in the bitter cold. Her tiny footprints in the snow led an officer to her body. And I have “09.16.13,” the date Derrail Roilton, a father of two, was found dead in the yard next to his mother’s home after being shot three times.
These murders and tragic deaths in Braddock, and others in similar towns and cities across Pennsylvania, became so normal that they were a talking point in our elected leaders’ speeches and footnotes in media stories.
**That’s why I have these tattoos. They are not some “costume.” They are reminders of the people we have lost and what I am fighting for. Both the dates on my right arm and the “15104” on my left — Braddock’s ZIP code — are personal to me.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-1?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221101-7984&refcode2=7984_434096_FpgTl0&akid=7984%2E434096%2EFpgTl0)
My decision to mark these deaths with tattoos was inspired in part by their permanence — the fact that these people, their stories and my town will be with me forever. I get that etching art permanently onto your body isn’t how most politicians would express their connection to their communities. But I don’t care about what anyone else thinks. It felt right to me.
I care deeply about my community and the people I represent. As mayor, I always felt a sense of obligation and responsibility for tragedies that happened under my watch.
**I put these dates on my arm because I realized that we had lost the shock of these deaths.** We became numb. I did it because I never saw the media or the public at large caring about these victims, most of them young Black men.
During my tenure as mayor, Braddock, which saw three homicides in the year before I became mayor, went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life through gun violence. We made a difference and we saved lives. It’s my proudest accomplishment in public service.
**I was a hands-on mayor and showed up at almost every crime scene because I felt a sense of duty to our community. I wanted to do everything I could to keep my town safe.**
That’s one of the core differences between my opponent for the U.S. Senate, Mehmet Oz, and me.
While he was making millions of dollars peddling "miracle cures" from a TV studio in Manhattan and living in a mansion on a hill in New Jersey, I was rolling up my sleeves and putting in the work to make my community safer. **I’m the only candidate in this race who has fought violent crime and won.**
**[If you’re ready to defeat Dr. Oz and send a real fighter for PA to the U.S. Senate, I need your support. Will you consider pitching in your first $5 today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-1?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221101-7984&refcode2=7984_434096_FpgTl0&akid=7984%2E434096%2EFpgTl0)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-1?refcode=em20221101-7984&refcode2=7984_434096_FpgTl0&akid=7984%2E434096%2EFpgTl0)**
The stories of the people whose lives we tragically lost still are with me every single day — not just on my arm but in every decision I make as an elected official.
They remind me of why I am here and why I’m doing this.
Thanks for hearing me out,
John
John Fetterman
Lt. Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Senate

clean_body: “Stupid little fake tattoos” Derek, Last month, Tucker Carlson went on a nearly 20-minute-long rant about me. The whole thing was as unhinged as you’d expect, but one line that stood out was about my tattoos. “All your stupid little fake tattoos,” he said, calling them a “costume.” I have nine dates tattooed on my right forearm. Each one is a day on which someone died violently in Braddock, Pennsylvania, while I was mayor. Gun violence and violent crime might be jokes to someone like Tucker, but they are very real to people in towns like Braddock. The first one that I tattooed on my arm is “01.16.06.” That’s the date on which Christopher Williams was shot dead while delivering pizzas. This was a man about my age at the time. He had a 12-year-old daughter. I just couldn’t get over the fact that he was never going home to her. Another tattoo reads “02.03.07,” the date that 23-month-old Nyia Page was found dead after her father sexually assaulted her and left her in the bitter cold. Her tiny footprints in the snow led an officer to her body. And I have “09.16.13,” the date Derrail Roilton, a father of two, was found dead in the yard next to his mother’s home after being shot three times. These murders and tragic deaths in Braddock, and others in similar towns and cities across Pennsylvania, became so normal that they were a talking point in our elected leaders’ speeches and footnotes in media stories. That’s why I have these tattoos. They are not some “costume.” They are reminders of the people we have lost and what I am fighting for. Both the dates on my right arm and the “15104” on my left — Braddock’s ZIP code — are personal to me. My decision to mark these deaths with tattoos was inspired in part by their permanence — the fact that these people, their stories and my town will be with me forever. I get that etching art permanently onto your body isn’t how most politicians would express their connection to their communities. But I don’t care about what anyone else thinks. It felt right to me. I care deeply about my community and the people I represent. As mayor, I always felt a sense of obligation and responsibility for tragedies that happened under my watch. I put these dates on my arm because I realized that we had lost the shock of these deaths. We became numb. I did it because I never saw the media or the public at large caring about these victims, most of them young Black men. During my tenure as mayor, Braddock, which saw three homicides in the year before I became mayor, went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life through gun violence. We made a difference and we saved lives. It’s my proudest accomplishment in public service. I was a hands-on mayor and showed up at almost every crime scene because I felt a sense of duty to our community. I wanted to do everything I could to keep my town safe. That’s one of the core differences between my opponent for the U.S. Senate, Mehmet Oz, and me. While he was making millions of dollars peddling "miracle cures" from a TV studio in Manhattan and living in a mansion on a hill in New Jersey, I was rolling up my sleeves and putting in the work to make my community safer. I’m the only candidate in this race who has fought violent crime and won. The stories of the people whose lives we tragically lost still are with me every single day — not just on my arm but in every decision I make as an elected official. They remind me of why I am here and why I’m doing this. Thanks for hearing me out, John John Fetterman Lt. name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Today is the last day to request an absentee or mail-in ballot.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
https://www.kpef.info [https://www.kpef.info]

Dear Friend,

This is an election that you absolutely cannot sit out. And we each have to make sure that your vote is counted. Because your vote is your power!

Today, Nov. 1, is the last day to request an absentee or mail-in ballot in PA. If you've been planning to vote by mail, your application must be received by your county election board [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] by 5 p.m. TODAY. You can request a mail-in ballot using this link [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/OnlineAbsenteeApplication/#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin] .

If you're a voter with disabilities or an illness that prevents you from going to your polling place on Election Day, or if you'll be out of town that day, today is also the last day to request an absentee ballot here [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/OnlineAbsenteeApplication/#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin] .

REMEMBER: Your mail-in or absentee ballot has to be received by 8 p.m. on Election Day, November 8. You can drop your ballot to a drop box or Election Office . Find a drop box here [https://vote.pa/return/] and find your county election office here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] . Before you submit your mail-in ballot, make sure it's all filled out — sign, date, seal, and stamp, if you're mailing it. Here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx] are details on how to fill out your ballot. If you don't receive your ballot in the mail at all, then contact your local election office [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] .

Visit our voting guide below if you have any additional questions, because we have answers.

KEYSTONE PROGRESS’ HOW TO VOTE GUIDE [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide]

And if you have an emergency [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx#emergency%20absentee] and miss TODAY'S DEADLINE, see about getting an emergency absentee ballot here [https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.vote.pa.gov_Voting-2Din-2DPA_Pages_Mail-2Dand-2DAbsentee-2DBallot.aspx-23emergency-2520absentee&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=XsZnG1pG3cn-u_vTtue7-zAyBy5WDSBlPqjy_XNOKwc&m=tG6r8QSlg05mIyCAxDVes_kMFBYaZIBw5QBCHtWOyDk&s=ie2nizkfR0MrCPAJhZqPJiMDxkQ5lB-VmGWDlB95B7M&e=] . You can also check the status of your ballot here [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/BallotTracking.aspx] , once you send it in or drop it off.

If you have any trouble voting, you can call 866-OUR-VOTE [tel:8666878683] .

And also, please forward this to your family and friends — your rights and democracy are on the ballot, and you need to make sure you act NOW before you miss your chance to vote.

See you at the polls!

Laura
Executive Director
Keystone Progress
