name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: what we talk about at dinner
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.
| | |
---
Peter, as a kid, no matter how busy my mom and dad were, we always sat down as a family to eat dinner together.
When I became a parent myself, I carried on this same tradition with my own family, and there was always an open seat and a full plate for anyone who wanted to join us.
While the food was usually delicious (especially once my son Matt started doing the cooking), the best part of dinner was always the conversation. **We came together as a family around the kitchen table to celebrate wins, talk through problems, and identify solutions – from the highs and lows of high school to the issues facing our country.** It was a time to pray together, reflect together, grieve together, laugh together, find connection, and dream big as a team.
**I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.** If you want to solve the problems that a community, state, or country faces, you should start by pulling up a chair and listening to the conversations families have over dinner.
Although I wish I could invite every single person on this team over to my own kitchen table, unfortunately, with the election just around the corner, that's not feasible. **[So instead, I'm inviting you to participate in my Dinner Table Priorities survey. Please, can you take just a moment to complete my survey before 11:59 p.m. tonight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53802070/376548835/1334226984?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk421-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjc2ODMxZi0wMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7Pdxl4VmkRgQ-6nSRrfKxF8qj0MPIsUMLZ8IpbucKY=&emci=19422c07-1056-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=f276831f-035a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=4450063)**

For me, leadership has always been about listening. That's how I led my family as a parent, that's how I best advocated for my patients as a nurse, and it's how I will lead Missouri as your next senator. I will always put families before politics, and I will be nobody's senator but yours.
That's why input from grassroots supporters has always been so central to this campaign. **And now, as we head into the final days of this election, I need to hear from you again – to hear what problems your family faces, what worries keep you up at night, and what you're most hopeful for. **
Your answers to this survey will be incredibly helpful in informing our campaign strategy for our Get Out The Vote efforts. **I'm reviewing responses first thing tomorrow morning, so I need to hear from you ASAP.[Please, will you make your voice heard tonight? With the election so close, hearing from grassroots supporters like you is incredibly important to our campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53802072/376548837/1334226984?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk421-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjc2ODMxZi0wMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e7Pdxl4VmkRgQ-6nSRrfKxF8qj0MPIsUMLZ8IpbucKY=&emci=19422c07-1056-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=f276831f-035a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=4450063)**

| | Peter, 239 days. That's how long American Hero and dedicated Soldier, Michael Williams, spent in an 8'x8' wooden box surrounded by barbed wire. He was forced to urinate and defecate in a water bottle. But that's not even the worst part...
None of this was at the hands of an enemy combatant **\- it was the U.S. government that treated this Warrior like a second-class criminal!**
---
[**DEMAND JUSTICE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775941:6DE7DsGGN:m:1:3371220873:31D4EA2396E0663B0955EC936F3C42D5:r)
---
Sergeant Williams was a battle-tested patriot. He always put the mission first and did anything to keep his fellow Soldiers safe - even on the mission that landed him in that wooden box.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775941:6DE7DsGGN:m:1:3371220873:31D4EA2396E0663B0955EC936F3C42D5:r)
---
Sgt. Williams was leading a squad in house-to-house combat. They were up against an insurgent group that used vicious guerilla tactics to take Americans down. ** ** When Sgt. Williams and his men entered a fortified compound, they found an enemy combatant armed with an AK-47. The barrel was still hot from shooting at U.S. forces. ** ** He faced a challenging decision: kill the enemy combatant or turn him loose and risk him killing even more Americans. Sgt. Williams wanted to keep his team safe, so he made the difficult choice to kill the combatant to protect his Soldiers and finish the mission. ** ** **Because of Sgt. Williams' decisive leadership, all of his men survived the operation.** ** ** But instead of treating this Warrior like the Hero that he is, the U.S. Government:
* _Charged him with murder_
* _Placed him in solitary confinement in an 8x8 wooden box_
* _Paired him with an inexperienced JAG officer who pressured him to plead guilty_
* _Rushed his trial in Kuwait _
* _Sentenced him to 25 years in prison_

---
[**HELP HIM GET JUSTICE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775941:6DE7DsGGN:m:1:3371220873:31D4EA2396E0663B0955EC936F3C42D5:r)
---
With your help, we've already secured parole for Sgt. Williams, but justice is still far from delivered... **UAP is working on getting Sgt. Williams a full presidential pardon, have these absurd charges dropped, and restore this Warrior's image - but we need all the support we can get to make it happen.** **Can you pitch in a few dollars to help this American Hero finally get justice?**
---
[**RUSH A DONATION**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61775941:6DE7DsGGN:m:1:3371220873:31D4EA2396E0663B0955EC936F3C42D5:r)
---
Unfortunately, this situation is all too common for our nation's heroes. That's why United American Patriots exists. _We step in whenever our Warriors are wrongfully accused and convicted of "War Crimes," and U.S. military prosecutors have failed them._ **The truth is that injustice can be an overwhelming battle. ** In order to obtain an effective legal defense team, almost every military defendant and their family must hire a civilian attorney. Many families are forced to take out mortgages on their homes, borrow money from friends and family members, and assume debt they will never be able to repay. **United American Patriots works with families to alleviate the financial burden and to "Defend our Defenders" through our WARRIOR FUND.** We pay for fees and associated expenses to ensure our nation's Warriors have the best attorneys, investigators, and experts on their side to preserve their rights and defend against wrongful accusations and convictions. **_The reason why is simple: because our Defenders deserve nothing less. _** Please support our mission to get Sgt. body:
| | |

Friend: Today, I wanted to reach out and tell you a little bit about myself. My story speaks to exactly why I'm in this fight – and it's important I share that with you.

First, here's a picture of me as a kid with a few of my siblings! (I'm in the bottom-right corner.)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778926/376460674/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)
I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah, Georgia. I had 11 brothers and sisters – and while my family was short on money, we were long on love and faith. My parents taught us the meaning of hard work and always said we could do _anything_ we put our minds to. Thanks to their support, I became the first in my family to earn a college degree.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778927/376460675/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)
From there, I followed in the footsteps of my mom and dad – both preachers – and eventually worked my way up to become the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, the spiritual home of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778928/376460676/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)
But I've always believed my impact doesn't stop at the church doors. That's just where it begins. That's why I ran for the U.S. Senate in the first place. Last year, with unprecedented grassroots support from folks like you, we made _history_. Now, I'm humbled to serve as Georgia's first Black senator and work hard to make sure every child can achieve their American dream – just like I did.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778929/376460677/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)
Here's the thing, friend: Keeping up this fight won't be easy. _NPR_ is calling me the most vulnerable Senate Democrat up for reelection – and experts confirm this race could decide Senate control.

**So the only way I can protect my seat and continue being a voice for Georgians is with your help.****That's why I'm personally asking:****[Will you chip in $5 or more today to help us close our budget gap, win in Georgia, defend the Senate, and secure a brighter future for our country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778930/376460678/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)**
Thank you for being part of our people-powered movement. As always, I'm so grateful for your support.

– Rev. Raphael Warnock
| | [Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53778931/376460679/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4770-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzhkODcwMS1lMzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwMc_N8U9ZuxQ804TuQfalXJGdbSmcOUbyFswKZ0Wt4=)

Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today.

So let me introduce myself – **[my name is April Becker and I’m running for Congress.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6d82d878c6314bb799372a5330346e71&_e=m_1Cgn0_TDpGHzUZA3wIvsbQQIAewpeofGdFLE-mSIKPtP0Q8sAbRn1c1_3LAM-eXFl_etzkKsI3LNR1VedmcvPUy06qbQH5-NXwSAqIpvjxLJc7Njxs73F0UhF-V5yUI3dh5XwAHEsoW6y6u0FdxiL3o0QkJFL_329OyLeCxLfjPlzu92PhPDEcpBIfueheqPjJ_BjwUEAUG9r0JfIdzRLR1ysepM6vRMJq8q0eiuq-Ncpt0No0asa0HVZiSlnsfxQCmp4kyEqmqFUS9QHHbyN-JBwykACVVgQIshPOlIeFQzy9esSkYhrUof4wT3JCiIxDsKKJTXaSpIayBoPjNKBS9DoDyBzPmgLFwGBmAbShRTZlabXE0hCgFM580f4BRqTaIUFXYbgW-SV6gZMClA%3D%3D)**

**I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could.**

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6d82d878c6314bb799372a5330346e71&_e=m_1Cgn0_TDpGHzUZA3wIvsbQQIAewpeofGdFLE-mSIKPtP0Q8sAbRn1c1_3LAM-eXFl_etzkKsI3LNR1VedmcvPUy06qbQH5-NXwSAqIpvjxLJc7Njxs73F0UhF-V5yUI3dh5XwAHEsoW6y6u0FdxiL3o0QkJFL_329OyLeCxLfjPlzu92PhPDEcpBIfueheqPjJ_BjwUEAUG9r0JfIdzRLR1ysepM6vRMJq8q0eiuq-Ncpt0No0asa0HVZiSlnsoJ1vXy5iYLY2l-2I4DQMsphVw0d26pRwPPoSc2GvAoR-VlgoLVJGeBXQ3SUvN2efwOcVY605B6ScAVBWGNCcRbTu3HnGz827xTYjaQzdypLOAWBsxleimx2KymOabGDyTPsZV-8iOmiCiq6DM_HoBw%3D%3D)

Tina for Oregon [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92654/images/TinaForOregon-Logo-FullColor-white.png]
Hey, everyone!

I just wanted to say thank you for your support this past month and during the entire campaign! In October, we saw the largest number of grassroots donors in a single month, with over 20,000 grassroots supporters chipping in to keep moving Oregon forward. And we hit our fundraising goal for the month!

This was our biggest month yet. We also welcomed a few new folks to #TeamTina — President Biden, former President Barack Obama, Senator Elizabeth Warren, and Senator Bernie Sanders — all of whom understand how important it is to keep Oregon blue.

I traveled across the state talking with Oregonians about making the economy work for everyone, protecting reproductive freedom, and standing up to right-wing extremism. It’s been so inspiring to watch Oregon come together to fight for our shared values, despite the attacks coming from my opponents.

Tina at Bernie rally [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92654/images/tk%20celebrating.png]

But there’s no other way to put it, Peter — this race is going to be tight.

With so many issues on the line – like homelessness, abortion rights, education, and climate change – we need everyone to get off the sidelines in this final stretch to Election Day.

We can see the finish line, and we can win! But it’s going to take all of us to make it happen.

THANK YOU for being a part of this team. We truly can’t do this without you.

We’ve got one week to go, and with Oregon’s future on the line, your support truly matters.

I’m grateful to have you standing with me.

— Tina

| | Dear fellow Mississippians, Dianne Black for Congress campaign launched the “Prepare Your Vote” campaign, providing North Mississippi voters with a [sample ballot](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/91OG09NFa/c?w=MqJtyB5FI0WS7_WuzDEwREEnfcsz7WmDXnXzLMyFTPI.)* for each of the 21 counties in the First Congressional District to see who is running for office on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, and prepare their vote. “Prepare to Vote” shares interesting statistics:There are close to 520,00 office holders in the United States. The vast majority, 96%, are local elected officials:135,531 city elected officials126,958 township members58,108 county officers95,000 school board members84,089 special district members* For this mid-term election, there are a substantial number of local races including Court of Appeals, Chancery County, Circuit Court, County Court, Levee Commissioners, and School Board.

Please consider making copies and sharing. Encourage qualified voters to absentee vote. Absentee in-person voting ends on Saturday, November 5 at noon for qualified voters. Mailed absentee ballots must be postmarked on or before November 8. Bad weather and long lines may dissuade some voters from casting their ballot on the one election day in Mississippi. There is no early voting in Mississippi! If you or someone you know is eligible to vote absentee, go ahead and vote! Do not wait until November 8. *Note: Each sample ballot provided is a compilation of all candidates running in all elections in that county, created to help residents plan their vote. Sample ballots may not be the actual ballot for a resident’s specific address. For example, in DeSoto County, James Eric Wright, who is running for school board District 1, appears on the District 1 ballot only. #
Friends,

Does the Right have a real plan for what to do when it retakes Congress?

What can the Right do to rebalance national power while halting the Left’s abuses, to punish their wrongdoing, and to stop what looks more and more like the beginning of a uniparty tyranny?

The next Congress must focus less on passing legislation and more on oversight of and investigations into the Left’s assets: its funding streams, the administrative state, and the intel state.

We will aim to answer these questions and more with the key thought leaders of the new right.

**EVENT** : _[What should a new GOP controlled Congress do?](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ab29fdb0a4&e=17913c7d6d)_

**TIME** : Wednesday, November 16th 9:00am - 4:00 pm. Doors open at 8:30am
_(breakfast and lunch will be provided) _

**LOCATION** : Hillsdale College, Kirby Center 227 Massachusetts Ave. NE Washington, DC 20002
---
|

| We'll be joined by members of Congress, esteemed professors, political activists, and other committed patriots. **Our own Russ Vought, President of Center for Renewing America, will also be speaking at this event. **

We’re co-hosting with The Claremont Institute for the American Way of Life, The Conservative Partnership Institute, Hillsdale College, and the American Conservative at the Kirby Center in Washington, D.C.

Together we can craft a Congressional agenda that can take back our country and stop the radical left.

[We hope you can make it](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d38f0c73c0&e=17913c7d6d)!

Already voted? Please get others to the polls! Here are three ways you can help:

1\. Text your friends reminders to vote.

I want everyone to grab five friends. The first five you can, and ask them what their plan to vote is. Then make sure they do!
They don’t have a plan? My team is here to help:
## _**[Make Your Plan to Vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53809091/376576161/-1612268846?refcode=20221101.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2MyODcwMC0xMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LcsEfM1zaCWjNShgKbSUxT0C31qigH8lXzweMAp-WFI=&emci=5a1cd876-005a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=b7c28700-135a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)**_
Whether you vote early or on Election Day, a few reminders when voting in person:
* You must be registered to vote in the county where you live. If you are already registered, you can vote at **any** early voting location **in the county you are registered in.**
* If you’re a registered Florida voter who has recently moved to a new county, be sure to **update your registered address** by contacting your county supervisor of elections or asking for help at your polling location when you go to vote.
* You need to bring a **photo ID** and a **signature ID** when you go to vote. This can be an ID that has both, such as a Florida driver’s license, or a credit card with a signature and a student ID with your picture on it.
* If you experience any problems with early voting, please call the Voter Assistance Hotline at **1-833-VOTE-FLA (1-833-868-3352).**

With one week to go, let’s make it count. Your support means so much, team — let’s win this for Florida, together.
– Charlie Crist

After spending my entire life in this state, I can say this with my whole heart: I love Missouri.
| | |
---
Peter, for four generations my family has called Missouri our home. I was born here, I grew up here, I raised my kids here, and I served my community as a nurse and advocate here. **[Now, I'm about to ask you to make an investment in the future of this beautiful state. Can you give me a minute to explain why?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53809811/376578312/-1746441832?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk449-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2VmOWFlNi0xMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K36AnKMxJ8rD4W3j8edFnb1JUd3qCY64T9D01WdaUXU=)**
**After spending my entire life in this state, I can say this with my whole heart: I _love_ Missouri.**
The deep forests of the Ozarks in the south, the bountiful plains up north that stretch on endlessly and feed our families, the great Missouri River that runs through our state – Missouri is, without a doubt, absolutely beautiful. But the real reason I'll always call the Show Me State home is the vibrant, diverse communities who also call her home.
Whether in our great cities like St. Louis, Kansas City, and Jefferson City or the tight-knit rural towns like Chillicothe and St. James that dot our state, the people here are one of a kind.
Missourians are bold, fiercely independent, and deeply loyal (especially to our baseball teams). As our Show Me State nickname implies, we have a healthy level of skepticism, and we refuse to tolerate any nonsense. **But more than anything else, we will do anything to defend those we love.**
I love Missouri and the families within, and it's been the honor of a lifetime to serve them as a nurse, volunteer, and advocate. **But it breaks my heart to watch this state be sold out for a fat check from corporate lobbyists, to watch our values be tossed aside in favor of personal ambition, and to see our leaders choose partisanship over people.** We deserve so much better. That's why I'm running for Senate – to give families the leadership that embodies true Missouri values: integrity, independence, and compassion.
I promise you that I'm in this race for the right reasons, and you have my word that I'll deliver real change for your family in Washington. But I can't beat my MAGA opponent without your help. **[So please, Peter, with just days until the election, I'm personally asking: Will you invest in a better, brighter future for Missouri and our whole country? I know that Missouri is ready to flip blue – but to win on Election Day, I am counting on your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53809812/376578313/-1746441832?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk449-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2VmOWFlNi0xMzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K36AnKMxJ8rD4W3j8edFnb1JUd3qCY64T9D01WdaUXU=)**

name: Matthew Diemer
subject: I'll show up
body:
| |
---
Peter, I am proud to be endorsed by Cleveland.com & The Plain Dealer. When I was asked to show up during this campaign, I did. Whether it was a right or left-leaning event – The Plain Dealer, League of Women Voters, Farm Bureau, HBA, or a round table, I showed up. **** I knew that not showing up, didn't hurt my campaign. It hurt the voter. So I was there. Most importantly, showing up is part of the job. How can I ask the people of OH-7 for a job, be expected to do it well, yet avoid the basic requirements? Answer: I can't, and I shouldn't. I'm disappointed that my opponent never showed up to non-partisan events. In terms of the Plain Dealer, he says it is because they are biased. However, the Cleveland Plain Dealer just endorsed a mix of candidates from both sides of the aisle. My opponent's decision to repeatedly not show up leaves me to believe a couple things: 1\. He doesn't care about the district as a whole based on his spotty record of showing up, listening, and engaging. When you care about your district's voice, you show up. It's not about you. I showed up because it's my responsibility & because in every situation where you can engage with a different voter, you learn something new. I could get insight into a part of the population I want to represent in DC. It's not about endorsements; it's about being present. 2\. He is afraid of being challenged because of a lack of character or substance. When you sit in front of people with different viewpoints, you need to articulate your thoughts or defend your beliefs. When you're all talking points, you can't do that. I believe my opponent can't articulate his beliefs and didn't think too deeply about them. Our platform was built by talking, listening, and working through problems. Listening builds consensus. I am open to change & compromise. Unite not divide. 3\. He doesn't feel that he needs to show up. It's been discussed a lot that there's a huge fundraising gap in our campaigns. So maybe he feels, "Why show up? I have more money." Or maybe by listening to people across our district shows people he is worried? The problem with not showing up during a campaign is that it shows you won't show up if elected. clean_body: | | Peter, I am proud to be endorsed by Cleveland.com & The Plain Dealer. When I was asked to show up during this campaign, I did. Whether it was a right or left-leaning event – The Plain Dealer, League of Women Voters, Farm Bureau, HBA, or a round table, I showed up. **** I knew that not showing up, didn't hurt my campaign. It hurt the voter. So I was there. Most importantly, showing up is part of the job. How can I ask the people of OH-7 for a job, be expected to do it well, yet avoid the basic requirements? Answer: I can't, and I shouldn't. I'm disappointed that my opponent never showed up to non-partisan events. In terms of the Plain Dealer, he says it is because they are biased. However, the Cleveland Plain Dealer just endorsed a mix of candidates from both sides of the aisle. My opponent's decision to repeatedly not show up leaves me to believe a couple things: 1\. He doesn't care about the district as a whole based on his spotty record of showing up, listening, and engaging. When you care about your district's voice, you show up. It's not about you. I showed up because it's my responsibility & because in every situation where you can engage with a different voter, you learn something new. I could get insight into a part of the population I want to represent in DC. It's not about endorsements; it's about being present. 2\. He is afraid of being challenged because of a lack of character or substance. When you sit in front of people with different viewpoints, you need to articulate your thoughts or defend your beliefs. When you're all talking points, you can't do that. I believe my opponent can't articulate his beliefs and didn't think too deeply about them. Our platform was built by talking, listening, and working through problems. Listening builds consensus. I am open to change & compromise. Unite not divide. 3\. He doesn't feel that he needs to show up. It's been discussed a lot that there's a huge fundraising gap in our campaigns. So maybe he feels, "Why show up? I have more money." Or maybe by listening to people across our district shows people he is worried? The problem with not showing up during a campaign is that it shows you won't show up if elected. It hurts the voters and our democratic process. Elect people that show up. That engage. That want to listen to all sides and are ok with being challenged and are willing to learn. That is how we break ourselves from this partisan political hell. Sincerely, Matthew Diemer Candidate for Congress OH-7 FIND YOUR POLLING STATION | Diemer for Congress P.O. subject: Where we stand with 1 week left
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221101&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221101&amount=28]
Team,
I can’t believe it, but there is only a week left until Election Day (it honestly can’t come soon enough).
We’ve come quite a long way since I announced I would be running for Michigan’s new 7th district. We started out with our "Snow Boots on the Ground" launch in the frigid Michigan winter, where we met new voters and asked them their priorities in Congress. And later today, Congresswoman Liz Cheney will visit the new 7th to join me for an "Evening of Patriotism and Bipartisanship" -- marking the first time Congresswoman Cheney will be campaigning for a Democrat. We're closing our campaign the same we started it: by making the positive and hopeful case for the future of American democracy.
Since those very first meetings during “Snow Boots on the Ground," this has turned into the most competitive House race in the state, and one of the most competitive (and expensive) House races in the entire country. I’m not a stranger to tough races. In fact, I’m the only Democrat left in the House that’s won in a district that went for Romney in 2012, Trump in 2016, and Trump again in 2020.
It’s also become clear that the road to keeping the House runs through Michigan. Right now, Democrats have a razor thin majority, and just last week the Detroit News released an article stating that three Michigan seats are a key part of their plan to flip the House – including mine.
We see a path to victory here, and I’m asking for your help to execute it. TV advertising has skyrocketed recently as demand for airtime has gone up way more than what we were anticipating. We’re competing with three competitive statewide races AND three ballot initiatives for time on the air. Ensuring our ads continue to run could make or break this race – so with 7 days left to go, I’m asking if you’ll chip in to help me in the new 7th. Contribute below to help me keep my seat AND keep the House. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221101&amount=28]

body:
It would mean the world to me if you could pitch in before Election Day.
#

Friends —
I wanted to pause for a moment and thank you for your support last month, and for being a part of this team.
We just wrapped up our final monthly fundraising deadline, and so many of you stepped up to help us hit our goal. I almost can't believe it. I've said it before, but when Gabby and I first launched this campaign we never would've expected more than a million people — A MILLION PEOPLE — would chip in to help me out. But you did.
Honestly, I can’t tell you how humbled I am to have your support — but we aren’t done yet.
There are still 7 days left to go before Election Day and we have to keep up the pace to hold off the MILLIONS flooding into Arizona trying to take back this seat.
That’s why my team and I have set one final goal: **$1 million by Election Day.** If we can accomplish this goal before the election it’ll give us the resources to fight back against the attack ads and make sure every vote is counted in this critical race. name: Cheri Beasley
subject: Thank you. Just 7 days until we win!
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I know we asked a lot of you in the lead-up to our deadline, but we are starting the final week of this race in an incredibly strong position.
#
I’m reaching out simply to say thank you.
I know we asked a lot of you in the lead-up to our deadline, but we are starting the final week of this race in an incredibly strong position. The polls show us tied, nonpartisan experts have moved us up the rankings, and North Carolina Democrats are turning out in force during early voting.
When we launched this campaign, I pledged to you and the people of North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever had to flip this seat and give folks a voice in the U.S. Senate. We deserve better than another DC insider who is beholden to giant corporations and the ultra-wealthy.
So for the next 7 days, my team and I are going to leave it all on the field. With hard work and faith, we can deliver meaningful progress for our families. Together, we can fix the broken status quo that puts our democracy, our planet and our rights at risk.
I promise to be a champion for you and help level the playing field for everyone when we flip this seat. And I stand firm in my commitment to cast the decisive vote to end the filibuster and make real change in Washington.
Onward to victory,
Cheri Beasley
P.S. If you can spare even an hour of your time, [**we urgently need more volunteers to help us get out the vote in North Carolina.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/5737?t=1&akid=2192%2E357359%2Es4GEfO) We know this race is going to come down to turn out, so you can make a big difference by helping us reach as many voters as possible.
If you didn’t have a chance to contribute last month, will you chip in today to help us turn out more voters? We have exactly one week until Election Day — and only a few more days of early voting, so this is important.
[**Please consider making a donation to our campaign to win North Carolina’s tied Senate race today. This is our best chance to flip a seat and expand the majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221101-1-MA&t=4&akid=2192%2E357359%2Es4GEfO)

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3ljrsqnfuqhuejsrnme62nmvh92d96hog7cfkg8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4c9keqrj4opj6eq6fdb36jgmatdh69h31p70c3g66p9gmlo63d5le4qr8tbl6srt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9rmcc3gmdie0tr3copb1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhmepj2cjiecp724no)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi43mmi9anbqsibqdda03at7ik4leg1gf6473k3o_rp22sh2s8i66or7cph69p76cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrudsmnehtvjfipvlh14p7hlseihp2g1hcgq8otg_rp22sh2s8i66or7cph69p76cjh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. You know how important this election is. Our democracy has never been so fragile.
Please send a message that every vote counts and should not be taken for granted. Voting restrictions and intimidation and false claims about elections need to stop.
Please send a message that we must stand against antisemitism, white national extremism, domestic terrorism, and political leaders who incite them or fail to stand against them.

subject: They earned it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Everywhere I go, I meet Kentuckians who are struggling to make ends meet
-- many are relying on Social Security to survive.

They earned their Social Security benefits. And they have the scars to
prove it: They have chapped hands, weak knees, and sore backs from a
lifetime of hard work.

They’re rightfully angry that Rand Paul cut taxes for billionaires, but
wants to CUT Social Security to pay for it.

If Rand Paul doesn’t understand that the senior citizens of Kentucky
deserve their benefits, then he doesn’t deserve to be our Senator. If he
wants to side with billionaires and big corporations over the people of
Kentucky, he cannot continue to serve as our Senator.

He needs to be held accountable at the ballot box. And I need you to help
me do it. So with just a few days left until Kentuckians head to the
polls, I need to ask for your support:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18818?t=1001&akid=2701%2E346206%2Eiwvz98 ]Will you pitch in $20 or more to help my campaign get out the vote and
send a message to Rand Paul that senior citizens deserve to retire with
dignity and respect?

CHIP IN →

We’ve got a huge end-of-month fundraising deadline coming up in just a few
hours, so I could really use your help.

Thanks for standing up for the people who need our help the most,

Charles

subject: Biden 2.0
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=fc3601dc5cf1dde47545b57820f52ac5315b70fed6b4358a700c44aa88534f040c3a7375d33e518aff331623eeeb14a9e0a81514aeffa78548efce7fcf643cf0961b1e7768bb9d8588fa834c6d0bd26a

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499

Peter,

Today, Joe Biden is visiting Florida to campaign for my opponent.

This doesn’t come as a surprise. Charlie Crist proudly calls himself a “Joe Biden Democrat” and repeatedly says he “thanks God for Joe Biden.” While other Democrat candidates have avoided Biden like the plague on the campaign trail, Charlie begged him to come to Florida to promote the Left’s woke agenda that would turn our state into a progressive dystopia.

Make no mistake: Joe Biden and Charlie Crist are two peas in a pod.

Floridians know how destructive the Biden Regime's policies have been for our country, but Charlie still thinks he is “doing a fantastic job.”

Two things are clear: Charlie Crist is just as incompetent as Joe Biden, and if elected, Charlie would do to Florida what Biden has done to America.

Under the Biden Regime:

▪️ Communities across the country are suffering from skyrocketing crime

▪️ Fentanyl is pouring in from the southern border claiming hundreds of lives a day

▪️ Woke teachers’ union bosses are fighting to overrule parents and indoctrinate our children in the classroom

▪️ Power-hungry, unelected bureaucrats are working to strip Americans of our rights with zero accountability
This is the Biden administration that Charlie Crist has nothing but praise for. In Congress, Charlie voted as a rubber stamp for Joe Biden's agenda 100% of the time.

It’s one thing for our country to be facing problems. It’s an entirely different story when those problems are 100% manufactured by the White House.

Since the day he stepped into the Oval Office, Biden has waged war on American energy, leaving our country beholden to foreign oil oligarchs.

He would rather fist bump with the Saudis and play footsie with the tyrannical Maduro Regime than use the resources our country is blessed with right here on American soil.

By Biden’s logic, domestic oil reserves are dangerous and threats to our climate, but oil sold by foreign dictatorships is “clean” energy.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499
FIGHT BACK AGAINST BIDEN’S WAR ON AMERICAN ENERGY

The southern border is in crisis under Biden’s watch, resulting in more illegal crossings taking place under his administration than any other time in our nation’s history. This wasn’t a mistake — it was the result of intentional actions that Biden took to reverse policies that were effective.

Biden’s Border Crisis has left communities across the country ravaged by drugs and crime. The Regime isn’t doing anything to solve the crisis at the border, because this isn’t a crisis Biden inherited — it’s a crisis Biden created. Like Biden, my opponent sees no problem with the border crisis at all.

Charlie Crist voted against funding and hiring additional U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers to help secure our southern border. What's more, Charlie endorsed making Florida a sanctuary state for illegal aliens to come live in (funded by you, the taxpayer).

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499
HOLD BIDEN ACCOUNTABLE FOR THE BORDER CRISIS

The Biden-Crist agenda is completely aligned with teachers’ unions who are attacking parental rights every day. In opposing the Parental Rights in Education law, Charlie Crist supports classroom indoctrination of young children with radical gender theory, sexual topics and transgenderism, even if their parents object.

The list of anti-parent attacks from Biden and Crist just goes on. Last week, Biden confirmed his full support for experimental transgender surgery for minors, criticizing states like Florida that make policies to protect children. Crist has long advocated for radical interventions like puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, and even surgery for children questioning their gender. The Left is on an all-out attack on childhood, sanity, and everything we hold dear.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499
FIGHT THE BIDEN-CRIST ANTI-PARENT AGENDA

Biden fully supports the Soros-funded prosecutors whose jailbreak policies are fueling the crime waves destroying cities across the country.

These woke prosecutors, radicalized by Left-wing pro-crime ideology, are refusing to uphold the rule of law. They are allowing violent criminals to walk away, free to victimize communities without consequence.

Charlie Crist sees no problem with this. In fact, he embraces these prosecutors with open arms, a direct threat to the safety of our communities.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499
KEEP WOKE PROSECUTORS OUT OF FLORIDA

My opponent classifies Joe Biden, who has driven our country into a downward spiral of chaos and destruction, as “the best president of our lifetime.” Biden and the Democrat Machine are advancing a far-Left agenda that will be the downfall of our great country if we don't put on the full armor of God and fight back.

This is what we’re up against on Election Day.

It’s not just a difference of opinions. It’s the difference between living in a state where your rights are protected or a woke dystopia where your rights are trampled on.

I’m fighting day and night to make sure Florida doesn’t fall to the Biden-Crist Agenda. But I can’t do it alone.

Freedom is on the line, and there is not a moment to waste.

I need the help of each and every supporter for the next seven days if we are going to win the fight to Keep Florida Free.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3f6d4371f6acab1ae43a52f7424ced527365a2acdb3b2c5567adfb9fa8c61e3739b5d70b501207bdcb46db5d0866a715dc69ddbffc89f499
>>>">Can I count on you to step up RIGHT NOW to help protect our state from woke radicals looking to do to Florida what Joe Biden has done to America? >>>>

DONATE NOW

RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT

KEEP FLORIDA FREE

For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

clean_body: Conservatives need to come together for this mission... | | | Friend, I’m reaching out to you about my friend, Hung Cao, who is running to represent Virginia’s 10th Congressional District. - Hung has an incredible story. His family fled Vietnam shortly before the fall of Saigon. The United States afforded his family a shot at the American Dream, and as a token of his gratitude, Hung vowed to serve his newly-adopted country. And he fulfilled that promise by serving in the Navy for 25 years as a Deep Sea Diver and Explosive Ordnance Disposal Officer. Shortly after retiring from the Navy last year, Joe Biden allowed Kabul to fall, leaving hundreds of Americans stranded while abandoning our allies. The fall of Kabul was eerily similar to the fall of Saigon, which inspired Hung to run for Congress. Friend, I bring all of this up because Hung is the type of service-minded conservative veteran and leader we need in Washington. But this race is incrediblyclose.There’s only a two-point differencebetween him and his opponent! Hung has a REAL shot at being a strong voice for Virginians in Washington. He has the message – and the momentum – to win this race. | | | Friends,

Election Day is just ONE WEEK AWAY!

Voters have multiple options for how to cast their ballot: in-person on Election Day, advance in-person, or through advance by mail ballot.

Get ready to cast your ballot with the following resources:
* [Locate your polling place](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=afb3dba7ae&e=e4cd931cf2)
* [Find your county's advance voting schedule](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=cda172798e&e=e4cd931cf2)
* [Check the status of your advance by mail ballot](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=739095e29a&e=e4cd931cf2)
* [Request an advance by mail ballot](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=51e89fe2e0&e=e4cd931cf2) \- TODAY is the last day to submit a request!

As you make a plan to vote, be sure to place your Schwab for Secretary of State sign in your front yard, and ask your family and neighbors to join you in supporting the Republicans on the ballot! Need a yard sign? Request yours [HERE](mailto:info@scottschwab.com?subject=I%20need%20a%20Schwab%20for%20SOS%20yard%20sign!).

Don't forget - Kansas state law requires voters to show photo ID when casting a ballot. Remember to take your photo ID with you!

Regardless of how you choose to cast your ballot, I hope you will participate in this important election.

Thank you for your friendship and support.

All my best,

subject: Mississippi Leadership Academy launches!
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132664?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,
**Liberty needs leaders, and to secure the future of the liberty movement in our state, we have launched the Mississippi Leadership Academy.** We held our inaugural session on Saturday.
---
|
---
| **Twenty young people are taking part in this six-part program is designed to equip them with the skills necessary to be effective change agents in Mississippi. **

The students, many of whom attend the University of Mississippi, Mississippi State University, Mississippi College and several local high schools, heard from former Representative Hon. Chip Pickering and the state director for Americans for Prosperity, Starla Brown.

MCPP CEO & President Douglas Carswell began the program by encouraging the students to think critically about issues within our state as they continue the course over the next six months. Pickering discussed what makes Mississippi a unique state, and Brown led her session on the importance of liberty.

**The students proved to be intelligent scholars, asking thought-provoking questions and engaging in unique discourse about public policy. **
---
|
---
| **The program ended with the students receiving two books — "Inventing Freedom," written by Daniel Hannan and "The Rational Optimist," written by Matt Ridley.** In a few months, the students will get to speak with both of these authors and ask questions about the books and the themes within them.
---
|
---
| The students will convene again in November for their second session where they will hear from State Auditor Shad White.

We're so thankful the first session was a success and look forward to meeting with our students again.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=ac8446d106&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Best,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

For decades now, Letitia has been a fearless advocate for New York – first as a City Council member, then as public advocate, and now as attorney general. She’s worked hard every day to protect the rights of every New Yorker, from the Bronx to Niagara Falls.

**But Peter, her fight for justice is far from over. Because right now, with voting rights, reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, gun safety, and more on the line, New Yorkers _deserve _an attorney general who will do whatever it takes to defend us. [So I have to ask: Will you make a donation to Letitia James’ campaign now to help her win re-election and defeat her Republican opponent?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53816371/376604559/379053316?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk891-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzNkNDlhOC0yNDVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A536jhBnedMcTF-kREOXoBpXg_lyLJOC8cuq_uO6-_w=)**

**[Will you make a donation to Attorney General James’ campaign now? name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I'm writing today to ask you to add your name to say you personally endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. With Election Day just 7 days away, we need to send a powerful message about the grassroots strength of this campaign.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
It's a small but meaningful action that would mean a lot in this moment.
#
Hi there, it's Mandela here.
I'm writing today to ask you to add your name to say you personally endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. But first, please give me a chance to explain why I'm coming to you with this request at this moment.
With Election Day just 7 days away, it's never been more important to show that you're a part of this team. Because the truth is that flipping Wisconsin's Senate seat and defeating Ron Johnson is going to require a grassroots effort larger than this state has ever seen.
So today, I need your help to send a powerful message about the strength of the movement that we're building together.
**I simply cannot beat Ron Johnson alone. It's going to require all of us.**
That is why I am asking you directly:
[**Add your name to say you support my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. That is just as true today as it was then. **My approach to leadership starts by listening first.** As I tell folks — we may not always agree, but I will always listen respectfully, work to understand your views, and find places where we share values and priorities. **Sometimes it seems like our politics have become a blood sport, with folks trying to beat each other over the head to prove a point._That is just not how I see the world._** I will always be true to myself and my deeply-held values — climate change is a terrible threat to our planet, we should not criminalize women's health care, our veterans deserve our respect, and hard working folks deserve a break once in a while. But I will also continue to listen to everyone in our community. Because feedback on _how_ we achieve these goals is important, even if someone is just there to tell me in no uncertain terms that they disagree with my priorities. clean_body: | | | | From my earliest days in public service, all I wanted was to be a voice for our community and for the people who had put their trust in me to represent them. That is just as true today as it was then. My approach to leadership starts by listening first. As I tell folks — we may not always agree, but I will always listen respectfully, work to understand your views, and find places where we share values and priorities. Sometimes it seems like our politics have become a blood sport, with folks trying to beat each other over the head to prove a point.That is just not how I see the world. I will always be true to myself and my deeply-held values — climate change is a terrible threat to our planet, we should not criminalize women's health care, our veterans deserve our respect, and hard working folks deserve a break once in a while. But I will also continue to listen to everyone in our community. Because feedback on how we achieve these goals is important, even if someone is just there to tell me in no uncertain terms that they disagree with my priorities. After all, this is not about me – but about what we can do together , for our community, our state, our country, and our planet. I am asking for your vote. I would be honored to continue to serve you, the people of Northwest Washington, in Congress. body:
When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfbc94rm6nom59tupfmnu39d6vl19ji85c4a3t68_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t77m3ib5c30m2qmaddlm9ob0thkcerm4plnc8o65c9mmuobcobncgqj4crlmkoefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7ephgeapm4ptie9j3co5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pr6cpgm6oj0s8iv0)

| |

| | | | | [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhob6pslq6eeucffm5uuv6uo372oc6iadcqsm81g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpj62or2c3h2bs)
---

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z1lgi7ns2o26p4ojnlqs9n57tmuqe3fqag3j2teo_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpj62or2c3h2bs)
---

Like you, I am also confronted with a highly complex set of problems, and I need the wisdom to try and make the right calls. _**So I need my mind renewed with the truth of the Gospel each day.**_

Unfortunately, faith-driven judgments are few and far between in Washington. Our leaders act without moral clarity and the consequences have been devastating.

If we are to restore honesty, integrity, and morality to our government, __**[we must elect more faith-driven leaders.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhds136da9ejiuk8vb2bcvi99suu5vedqi73fpe0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cpj62or2c3h2bs "we must elect more faith-driven leaders.")**__

| Team,

November is Native American Heritage Month, and it’s important we pause to honor and celebrate Arizona’s Native communities and people.

More than 12,000 years ago, Native and Indigenous people inhabited the land that would become Arizona and to this day, there are 22 federally recognized tribes, and many more Native communities throughout our state.

In fact, the two largest tribal lands in the U.S. are in Arizona. Their contributions to our state are numerous, and it’s important for us to recognize that throughout this month.

So while we celebrate the rich tradition, beautiful culture, and continuous contributions of Arizona’s Native communities this month, let’s also commit to continuing to treat these communities with dignity and respect throughout the year.

There’s still much progress to be made for Native people and communities in Arizona, and we commit to being a part of that progress.

Thank you to our Native communities for all they do for Arizona.

Sincerely,

AZ Dems

subject: Special Session Update
body:

---

| | | Don't Pass a Bill Like Nancy Pelosi |
---|---|---
| In 1936, Mississippi became the first state in the nation to come up with the idea of giving away money to entice companies to move to our state, and yet we are still in last place economically. The idea of paying companies to come to Mississippi has not worked and increasing the amount of corporate welfare with the "biggest economic development" project in Mississippi history is not the direction in which we should continue. We still know very little about the newest economic development project, and will be asked to vote on the bill in less than 24 hours. This is a complete and utter failure of the process for which the tax payers of Mississippi should hold their politicians accountable. We can only hope that leadership won't ask us to pass the bill to find out what is in it, but given the sheer magnitude of the project, why should we be asked to vote on a bill in a special session where Legislators and the public are being kept in the dark? We ask that leadership release the full details of the project and what the costs will be to tax payers with substantial notice so that lawmakers can review the details. Calling a special session with 2 days notice and still not having any details of the legislation less than 24 hours before gaveling in is UNACCEPTABLE.[CLICK HERE - Tell your legislator to vote NO on back-room bills](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/3cez9zl8R0CInKaZPVXkWQ)

What do you say?
#
Derek, buckle up for some not-so-great news:
I couldn’t be any more grateful to all of yinz + youse who pitched in toward our final end-of-month deadline. **But my team did the math, and unfortunately, we fell exactly 4% short of our $5 million goal.**
With just one week left (!!!), we’ve absolutely gotta close this gap ASAP if we’re going to defeat Dr. Oz + flip this seat blue.
**I don’t want to wake up in eight days knowing I didn’t give this race my all, and I bet you feel the same.[So please Derek, make a donation of any amount to our campaign today to close this gap, even just $3.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-2?refcode=em20221101-7996&refcode2=7996_434096_fY58LV&akid=7996%2E434096%2EfY58LV)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221101-7996&refcode2=7996_434096_fY58LV&akid=7996%2E434096%2EfY58LV)**
Our race — and control of the U.S. Senate — will be decided over the next seven days.

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Uniting police with Black communities
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778003:6AcIfsGCN:m:1:3253819041:2A4FFCB73E26BCFC840883BEB57D1683:r)

Hello Peter,

The Left wants the next generation of Black Americans to self-destruct. They have set out to destroy our families, defund the police, and leave our communities vulnerable.

And if the Left succeeds, the next generation will have no family to support them and become victims of crime in their own neighborhoods.

I saw a video of a group of Black teens DESTROYING a local store in their own community. This was where their parents and grandparents shopped, and these children destroyed it for no reason -- _**just because they were bored.**_

My name is Brandom Tatum, an ex-police officer and co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation.

**BLEXIT is extending an opportunity for you to get involved and empower Black communities by opening pro-police dialogues.**

Peter, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 in the next 48 hours to support our work to build strong communities and stop the over-incarceration of minorities among the next generation.

[_**Can you join us in our mission by sending a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778003:6AcIfsGCN:m:1:3253819041:2A4FFCB73E26BCFC840883BEB57D1683:r)

The only limits we face come from the person in the mirror.
* Not from our skin color.
* Not from where we grow up.
* Not from a broken family.

This is a deeply personal topic to me. I served in the Tucson Police Department as a SWAT operator, field training officer, general instructor, and Public Information Officer.

**I know how important it is to create relationships between police officers and these communities.**

Black communities must end the victimhood mentality that the media and other organizations force on us. It's why BLEXIT stresses the importance of education, family, the presence of a father in the home, and the support of a strong community to _**avoid**_ incarceration.

[_**Support BLEXIT 's mission to reach urban communities >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778003:6AcIfsGCN:m:1:3253819041:2A4FFCB73E26BCFC840883BEB57D1683:r)

When I co-founded BLEXIT, I promised myself that we would not be just a "think tank" but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank."

We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing and going places that are often ignored, like Detroit and Baltimore.

We believe there are five primary program areas in which BLEXIT Foundation must engage to change the narrative surrounding America's minority communities.
* Advocating for School Choice.
* Promoting a pro-police criminal justice reform.
* Championing entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
* Developing history programs that will inspire minority children.
* Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

All while championing our values of faith, family, and freedom to empower Black and minority communities.

Peter, can you help BLEXIT build bridges in these communities by helping me reach my goal of raising $24,000 in the next 48 hours? **Click below to send your gift. **

# [Support saving our Bees and Pollinators and Plant Native](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/11/01/support-saving-our-bees-and-pollinators-and-plant-native/)
| | theresacoatesellis Nov 1
---|---
By: Councilwoman Theresa Coates Ellis -- With many initiatives brought forth for the good of the community, one that I am most passionate is saving our pollinators. As a Master Gardener trained years ago with the [Prince William Master Gardeners](https://mgnv.org/) (they still train interested gardeners!), I plant native in my home, taught students, homeowners, landowners and as your Manassas City Councilwoman the importance of this best practice. This is the best guide for planting native: [Native Plants for Northern Virginia](https://www.plantnovanatives.org/) and has a free PDF version to download for reference.
During the COVID 19 pandemic, I was the patron for the historic garden at Liberia House working with Manassas City, gardeners, naturalists, and lovers of nature to plan and dig to install these native plants. Once the garden was established, we celebrated saving the pollinators. Today we are thankful to the Prince William Master Gardeners and local gardeners and naturalists who maintain the gardens -- they always need help -- reach out to them if interested on their website: [mgnv.org](https://www.mgnv.org).
After several years of planning and visiting with committees in the City, I worked closely with the Beautification Committee, the City staff, [Prince William Area Beekeepers Association](https://pwrbeekeepers.com/) (they teach how to be a beekeeper!), Master Gardeners, Native and Wildflower Gardeners, Naturalists and Native Bee specialists for a [Bee City USA](https://beecityusa.org/) designation for Manassas City. Council approved the resolution unanimously. I even featured the beekeeper in one of my [Shadow for a Day programs](https://business.facebook.com/TheresaEllisforManassas/videos/346914312987834/) \-- connecting students and learners with careers and interests.
With that designation, the annual [Manassas Bee Festival ](https://www.facebook.com/events/310849387790009/?ref=newsfeed)was launched with thousands in attendance at Liberia House now with an apiary that my husband and I maintain with fellow beekeepers to teach about bees, pollinators and native plants to the community.
Our next Manassas Bee Festival will be Sat., June 24th 10am-2pm during Pollinator Week. We are continuing to raise awareness to plant native, encourage natural habitats for pollinators, and to save the bees and all pollinators in decline who are critical to our growing food source.
I hope I can count on your vote for re-electing Theresa Coates Ellis to Manassas City Council to continue this important work as an elected official to benefit our future. Early voting is now until Sat. Nov. 4 at 9025 Center St. Manassas or on election day on Nov. 8th at your regular precinct.

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=66cdfe4f4d&e=3cd8121505)

# Dear supporters,
Early voting is going well, but we once again have to ask for your help!

This Saturday, November 5th at 10am, we will be joined by Congressman David Trone and Speaker Adrienne Jones of the Maryland House of Delegates for a final rally and canvass at the Washington County Democratic Central Committee headquarters (140 W. Washington Street, Hagerstown, MD).

Heads are turning and attention is being brought to our race specifically, so we need to have a strong turnout of volunteers for this! Register here for free: [https://www.mobilize.us/davidtrone/event/520072/](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=e8b3eff0be&e=db24e76724).

REMINDER: We are also still looking for Team Brooke volunteers to represent us at the polls on election day (Tuesday, November 8th, any hours from 7am to 8pm). If you're interested in that, please email me directly at brettguess01@gmail.com with your hours of availability and whether you would like to be assigned to a particular location.
It is also a great time to get in your last donations! We need support as we pump money into advertisements in the home stretch.
[https://donorbox.org/grossman-for-hagerstown](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=780612c5e3&e=db24e76724) We got this,

Brett Guessford

>
If we send Mandela to Washington, flip another Senate seat, and hold onto the House, we can finally get past the filibuster and ensure abortion rights across the country as early as January.
And we can send Ron Johnson packing. Boy does he deserve it:
* He’s said he wants to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block every year.
* He’s looked out for wealthy donors and giant corporations at the expense of the working people of Wisconsin.
* He celebrated the end of Roe v. Wade and co-sponsored eight nationwide abortion bans — including one with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother.
* He said insurrectionists were “peaceful” protestors and personally tried to hand a slate of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6 to overturn his own state’s election results.

Enough is enough. We’ve got to get him out of the Senate.
And Mandela will make us proud in Washington.
As a senator, Mandela will fight to put our government on the side of hardworking families like the one he grew up in. His mom was a Milwaukee school teacher, and his dad worked the third shift at the General Motors plant. Those were solid, middle-class union jobs — the kind of jobs that could support a family. The kind of jobs that have slipped away as giant corporations have tilted the playing field in their favor.
Mandela became a community organizer to fight for good local jobs, stood up to Scott Walker as a member of the State Assembly, and teamed up with Tony Evers as his running mate to defeat Walker in 2018.
As lieutenant governor, Mandela has fought for families across Wisconsin, and he’s ready to keep up the fight in Washington to rebuild the middle class, root corruption out of Washington, and strengthen our democracy.
**But first, we’ve got to do everything we can in this last week to get Mandela over the top.**
[_**Time’s running out. I’m only asking because it would still make a real difference: Can you split a contribution between Mandela Barnes and Warren Democrats right away? The polls are neck and neck — Ron Johnson is ahead by just one point in CNN’s latest. Out-of-state Republican groups have spent millions of dollars against Mandela. We’ve got to help him fight back. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = If we send Mandela to Washington, flip another Senate seat, and hold onto the House, we can finally get past the filibuster and ensure abortion rights across the country as early as January. And we can send Ron Johnson packing. Boy does he deserve it: He’s said he wants to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block every year. He’s looked out for wealthy donors and giant corporations at the expense of the working people of Wisconsin. He celebrated the end of Roe v. Wade and co-sponsored eight nationwide abortion bans — including one with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. He said insurrectionists were “peaceful” protestors and personally tried to hand a slate of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6 to overturn his own state’s election results. Enough is enough. We’ve got to get him out of the Senate. And Mandela will make us proud in Washington. As a senator, Mandela will fight to put our government on the side of hardworking families like the one he grew up in. His mom was a Milwaukee school teacher, and his dad worked the third shift at the General Motors plant. Those were solid, middle-class union jobs — the kind of jobs that could support a family. The kind of jobs that have slipped away as giant corporations have tilted the playing field in their favor. Mandela became a community organizer to fight for good local jobs, stood up to Scott Walker as a member of the State Assembly, and teamed up with Tony Evers as his running mate to defeat Walker in 2018. As lieutenant governor, Mandela has fought for families across Wisconsin, and he’s ready to keep up the fight in Washington to rebuild the middle class, root corruption out of Washington, and strengthen our democracy. clean_body: Join Us!| | | Fellow American, Politicians and partisan talking heads talk an awful lot about the idea of unity...but it usually comes with conditions and party loyalty. But what does unity mean to you? To us at An America United , unity means bringing people together around shared beliefs to achieve a common cause for the greater good. | | | | Unity is putting our best ideas into action to get positive results, regardless of who gets the credit. In today's hyper-partisan, polarized world, we know it can be unthinkable that Americans can be brought together around one shared agenda. But we founded An America United with leaders like Governor Larry Hogan to prove that although difficult, it isn't impossible. In deeply blue Maryland, Governor Hogan showed that unity can be achieved when we channel the courage to come out of our partisan corners and reach across the divide for inspiration and ideas. The result? A Republican governor with a 70%+ approval rating, including high marks from the other party's voters. That's unity in action! If you agree with our unity agenda, please don't wait to join. Help us cut through the noise of the hyper-partisans and show them Americans are ready to unite to find a better way forward. body:
| | | Hi friend, it's Carole King.

I want to talk to you about November 8th. Not this year—I’m talking about November 8th, 2016, when Hillary Clinton lost the election.

**Do you remember what that felt like? I do.**

I remember feeling so optimistic that morning. That night my optimism turned to shock, then disbelief, then finally depression as I thought about all the people who would be hurt by Trump and the GOP’s reckless cruelty. And I had no idea then how bad it would get.

I’ve been so proud of Democrats who’ve been fighting so hard to get America back on track. Even as Republicans continue to seek power for power’s sake, Democrats are seeking power to lift everyone up!

**I don't want all that progress crashing to a halt. I don't want to see the Senate fall back into the hands of Republicans who peddle cruelty and lies until they're caught and then they change their stories.

This year, I want November 8th to reaffirm the decency of most Americans—and I believe with all my heart that there are more of us!**

[**So let me personally ask you: Will you join me and make a $5 contribution to the DSCC to defend our Democratic majority in the Senate, so we can stop Mitch McConnell from taking over and harming America for the sake of political power? For a limited time only, a group of donors will QUADRUPLE your gift >>**](https://go.dscc.org/go/10816?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20221101-CaroleKing-CaroleKingV4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20221101-CaroleKing-CaroleKingV4-Pros-sl1&akid=8361%2E9716520%2Evngdz9)

With just a few days left until this November 8th, the DSCC and I are counting on you to help expand our Democratic Senate majority. And I’m confident that there’s nothing we can’t achieve when we stand together.

With gratitude and best wishes to you and your family,

— Carole | [](https://go.dscc.org/go/10816?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20221101-CaroleKing-CaroleKingV4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20221101-CaroleKing-CaroleKingV4-Pros-sl1&akid=8361%2E9716520%2Evngdz9)Carole King is a singer-songwriter, author, and activist. subject: Here’s my plan for the last week of the campaign
disclaimer_text:

Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110122 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110122] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Friend,
This is it. The final week before Election Day. Together, we’ve been on an incredible journey and I want to take a moment to thank you for supporting this campaign.
Whether you made a grassroots donation, stuck a yard sign in front of your house, attended a rally, or just had a conversation with someone you know about the importance of protecting our elections, you have played a critical role in our pro-democracy movement.
I also hope that you’ve cast your absentee ballot or have a plan to vote on Election Day. If you have any questions about your voting plan, you can visit Michigan.gov/Vote. [Michigan.gov/Vote] There you’ll find a comprehensive resource tool kit that will ensure you’re able to cast a ballot on or before November 8th.
Now, we’ve got one week until Election Day, and there’s still a lot more work to do to ensure that democracy wins at the ballot box.
Here’s my plan. Since 2020, we’ve ensured that our elections remain accessible, secure, and transparent for every Michigan voter. Over these next seven days, I’ll be working with my fellow election officials to guarantee that every vote is counted in our state and that our election system continues to reflect the will of the people.
I’m also going to continue to hit the campaign trail to spread our message across the state! It’s been inspiring to meet so many supporters in person, and if these rallies are any indication, I know a powerful pro-democracy coalition is going to turn out next Tuesday.
In case you’re wondering, here’s what you can do to help. I know you’ve already voted or made a plan to vote by Election Day. Now, you need to make sure that every one of your family members, friends, and neighbors is participating in this historic election, too! Our democracy is only as strong as the people who support it, so let’s work together to make sure we turn out the biggest possible coalition of voters on November 8th.
Of course, it’s impossible to personally talk to every voter in our state. That’s why our campaign is continuing to run ads on TV and spreading our call to get out the vote. Over these next 20 days, this campaign is going to be working hard to get-out-the-vote to ensure my re-election. Will you support this effort today, friend? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110122]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110122 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110122]Thanks again, friend. Now let’s go win this.
Onward,
-Jocelyn

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I’m in it to win it, but I need your urgent help – Your donation will be the difference-maker in this race. If McMullin flips this seat, Democrats will likely hold the Senate majority. We cannot let that happen! I need to hear from you in the next hour – Thank you for your consideration, Mike Lee Father. Husband. Constitutional Conservative.
