MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.

During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. [Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up making billions of dollars over the course of those five days.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/4PfL751D8g4IfLXFw3QfXV5Wo_6TP_ujTmJFoO05AE0Vd8nKqW85ZXV9rlZ14r6UlFGxZdP3AdeoGIM0LoQwYINEi5s2FNTQf1gbzXRusRDkVFQwqNRM1Ky_sTEzbjzoTatWIxWZieQseJR6m4-J2ffErhzzOjo6vs7EitPOrlxgcUCfSbOBiIeJdFMM4EKJPn8AMYLgHqs9SfAA9pB3IZh0YebbRKR46melixXa-TRTpKa3PFkMW0IStZFiNxOTZFXB_vabP29ljVg1Yg4Z39tqrtDQdJ8MUEx0vQtR5QwewQYIzDK1bw72mKORiuNBFAIWXPSobq71zltmJVFAOWKy88n3gUgiMkq__YuJWubJ8-WvRo2rY5pL-x4Mrv743CAfUs1IMh7iRlXAqCZ8meoyPq7oSf1biAbNWVTkI7ERYhyQ3DyGd8rLlI3ulRBSRHU_LF3htl5fmfocbZxeVupg28VJ_ou7-0nPM98rAokzQKyWPYIi4JOnzJY1B__l/3qs/lZDlNsFjSrKoXXlz_m2K6g/h9/XnHbSWHy4UDXRSC9V3UqhO4T-x89DDcAnPiph6Nn6nA) The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.

This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.

This week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.

What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of Texas.

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. clean_body: | | | Team Ruiz hopes that you and your family are safe and healthy. Public health across the country is our top concern during this unprecedented time. To view the most up to date CDC COVID-19 safety recommendations, And if you have a moment, please read our message below. DearI don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important place than what's happening in Texas today. | | | | | | | It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm. During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result. This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas. This week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets. What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of Texas. The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and they're showing up. | | | | | | Thank you, Beto | PO Box 1566 Indio, CA 92202 PAID FOR BY DR. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, I know we’ve sent you too many messages over the past few
days asking you to help us reach our end-of-October fundraising goal. And
I can’t thank you enough for all you did for me.

Today, I wanted to take the time to say thank you for supporting this
campaign. Thank you for trusting in our movement and for believing in the
work I will do as Kentucky’s next U.S. Senator.

I could not do this work without your support, Peter.

When elected into the Senate, I will continue to stand up, give back, and
get things done for ALL of Kentucky.

Your support is recognized and appreciated. Your contribution has allowed
me to reach thousands of potential voters and pay the team fighting for us
in the streets every day.

All my best,

Charles

name: Ken Burns
subject: We're on the cusp of a momentous point in history.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling.
#

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
We’re on the cusp of a momentous point in history. This November’s election is our chance to fortify our democracy and Constitutional rights by electing leaders who understand our history and envision a better and brighter future for us all.
We must expand our Senate majority, and one of our best chances to do that is to elect a true trailblazer in North Carolina: Cheri Beasley.
She’s already been a history maker as the first Black woman to serve as Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, where she proved to be a relentless fighter for justice and the people of North Carolina.
Now we have the chance to elect her as North Carolina’s first Black Senator and only the third Black woman to ever serve in the U.S. Senate.
But history doesn’t happen by itself. We each have a role to play, so I am personally asking you:

body:
| | | [](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=518d9c11df&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter:Ephesians 6:12 tells us: _"For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms."_ My friends, when St. Paul wrote this he was facing vastly different times than we are now, yet his words still resonate with us today because this is where Biden the Usurper has placed us; deep in a struggle to keep America safe from tyranny.Our struggle as Conservatives is not against anything heavenly, but is instead against the destruction of the American way of life we all love and that the Good Lord Above has created for us.Our struggle is against the authorities who we call “THE DEMOCRATS” but who in reality are a global cabal assembled to turn this nation into a socialist nightmare state bereft of the freedoms granted us by The Constitution and The Bill of Rights.My name is **Irene Armendariz-Jackson** and I am a successful **Latina** (not “Latinx” because “EX” means “mistake”) who is living the American Dream every day. I’m the proud daughter of LEGAL immigrants, and a loving parent fighting to keep America safe for my children.I am also a “border wife” who sees first-hand the devastation of Biden’s still-unexplained opening of the southern border. The sex trafficking, the gun-running, the rape of women and children — these are not just Fox News headlines to me. My husband sees this every day as a Border Patrol agent and his stories really make my blood boil. For this reason I’m running for Congress to help make America stay the same wonderful SAFE country my family LEGALLY immigrated too.Right now we are facing daily illegal border crossings of UNKNOWN illegal aliens from every country on earth! This has gone on almost since day one of the Biden Administration and, as far as I can tell, no one has ever been given a common sense answer for it OR EVEN ASKED WHY? And all during an alleged PANDEMIC that no one in the Democrat party seems to be scared about.**So who does this benefit?** Certainly not the American taxpayer whose money will go to housing, healthcare and education for these illegals.Certainly not the parents of children who will face increased crime and violence in the streets.Certainly not the American worker whose job opportunities will be substantially lessened by cheap illegal labor.No, simply put, Joe Biden’s plan is **EVERYTHING BAD FOR AMERICANS!**
| [DEFEAT THE BIDEN ENABLERS IN CONGRESS!](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=bf354b83f7&e=fdefed58de)
---
So Isaiah 41:10 teaches us:_"So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand."_ As a Christian my heart goes out to anyone forced to flee their homeland for sanctuary, and America is the place to come to IF YOU DO SO LEGALLY. But what the Biden Administration is doing must shock the conscience AND THE SOUL of every America-loving patriot, Christian or otherwise. God will indeed strengthen us and help us defeat this scourge, just as he helped _Moses defeat Pharaoh_ , but we have to help Him out by doing our part as America First Conservatives.
And so I’m asking for your help and support in my battle to RESTORE AMERICA! We have an election in just TEN SHORT DAYS and we need EVERY bit of help making sure that we WIN this race and defeat Veronica Escobar and her open borders agenda!**Will you stand with me today and help us restore the safety and security of our nation?**

I wanted to share a little bit about my story, and why I’m in this fight, Friend. **[I hope you’ll take a moment to read this message, but if you’re already with me, will you chip in to my campaign and Brittany’s to get us one step closer to Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811097/376583007/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811098/376583008/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=) **Family means everything to me.** My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and family. They raised me and my siblings with those values — on a construction worker’s pay in the Adams County home they still live in. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811099/376583009/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=) **I put myself through undergrad and medical school, becoming the first person in my family to graduate from college.** But even before I finished my medical training, advocacy became an important part of my life. I helped organize my fellow medical residents for better working conditions, and became a union representative with SEIU. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811100/376583037/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=) I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community – to the folks that raised me. **But I quickly understood that truly helping children required a lot more than what I was able to do as a doctor.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811101/376583038/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=) **That’s why I ran for the state legislature.** In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic. And, Friend, that’s why I’m running for Congress. I promise you that I will continue my commitment to the families I see every day in Colorado. I will build on my work to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. **[I’m ready to bring this fight to Congress, but I can’t get there alone. I need your help. So please, will you chip in to mine and Brittany Pettersen’s campaigns today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53811102/376583039/-858732369?refcode=email_110122_PettersenCaraveoSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTQwNzlhZi0xNzVhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw9LA817EAj7mkkp86i3z8mISRbFH8sGOATXhxBc8UA=)**

This weekend, Brazilians appear to have embraced an opportunity that could prove to be historic--not only for Brazil, but also the rest of the world. Meanwhile, our vestiges of democracy here in America continue to crumble, with political violence predictably rising in response to failures across all of our democratic institutions.
Writers who abandoned democracy in a time of relative peace now wring their hands at the political violence invited by their failures, punching down at voices who observe what they lack the independence to acknowledge.
### "Democracy" in America
#### The "Soft despotism" foreseen by de Tocqueville
Two centuries ago, Alexis de Tocqueville traveled the nascent United States and wrote a two-volume analysis of "[Democracy in America](https://substack.com/redirect/acd8c2c4-c84d-46c8-8d33-6e85ca2c7088?r=1hvr60)." Many of his observations proved to be phenomenally prescient, including his anticipation of the "soft despotism" that has come to unfortunately characterize our Republic.
Most Americans have long maintained a mistaken faith in our system, both in the sense that they presumed its integrity for no good reason, as well as its longevity despite our government's recurring habit of shooting our country in the feet. For better or worse, that faith has been widely shaken by recent events.
None of America's democratic institutions are functioning today.
Our elections have been reduced, at best, to contests among corporate fundraisers. At worst, they are case studies in [racist intimidation](https://substack.com/redirect/734be8cd-4587-4d0b-a7d3-866bc27ddd08?r=1hvr60) of voters by right-wing vigilantes, alongside racist & [homophobic](https://substack.com/redirect/3d960dfa-b841-4687-b445-72037d3a829e?r=1hvr60) ad hominem [character assassination](https://substack.com/redirect/85614852-a81a-4dd7-af0d-4b82677111c2?r=1hvr60) by Democrats punching left to defend their corporate leaders. All of this distracts the public from crucial questions of policy, justice, and accountability--while precluding opportunities for institutional change by entrenching career, corporate, and dynasty politicians.
Meanwhile, our courts have been effectively taken over by the right wing, which has all but closed the doors to justice. This might seem new to some people, but sadly it's not news to me.
The _Bush v Gore_ decision in 2000 was among the first Supreme Court cases handed down after I had recently started law school. It indirectly enabled everything from [the Court packing itself](https://substack.com/redirect/ec73e557-7f70-46f3-af25-d1f8df8028df?r=1hvr60) to multiple [fraudulent](https://substack.com/redirect/ca5153c4-2585-49b2-bf4f-cc36a4fceda1?r=1hvr60) wars of [aggression](https://substack.com/redirect/c8af5f60-a162-4105-8536-2def288e7bec?r=1hvr60) around the world, each of which [accelerated](https://substack.com/redirect/cdc85ef4-cf0b-4112-90bf-913b105c7233?r=1hvr60) the global climate catastrophe, left millions dead, and created further geopolitical instability and conflict.
The _[Dobbs](https://substack.com/redirect/91c5eb8f-43fd-45e7-bf05-8c99cb481b7c?r=1hvr60)_ decision this spring forced millions of complacent liberals into the streets, seemingly oblivious of the _[Carhart](https://substack.com/redirect/d253ed35-5cc7-4fc8-8ba5-f4253344806f?r=1hvr60)_ decision that actually overturned _Roe v Wade_ [15 years ago](https://substack.com/redirect/fe64144f-3967-48f0-94a5-9a0a6fbdf0d2?r=1hvr60).
Nothing about the right wing weaponization of the Supreme Court is new. It has simply grown so extreme now that even institutional apologists (like the journalists who have long reported on the Court without observing its arbitrary politicization) have been shocked into finally recognizing trends that have shifted the ground beneath their feet.
Both the majoritarian aspect of democracy (elections), and the mechanisms for counter-majoritarian checks on the tyranny of the majority (embodied in our courts) have more or less collapsed.
What remains?
The press is often described as a Fourth Branch of government, which is apt given its theoretical role in enabling transparency. But journalism in the U.S. has descended into a twisted joke.
I've written [recently](https://substack.com/redirect/4f07d3fa-5710-457e-9826-5326871aca34?r=1hvr60) about how the _New York Times_ kept George W. Bush in the White House in 2004 by keeping the public in the dark about his secret, unconstitutional, and illegal authorization of mass wiretapping.
Others among my posts have explored the absurd tendency of journalists to [publish clickbait](https://substack.com/redirect/63c54a6d-601f-4461-baf6-6590467dc2d7?r=1hvr60) even at the cost of accuracy, ethics, and the accountability goals to which their profession is supposedly committed.
Many have observed how the implosion of the classified advertising industry (driven by the rise of the Internet) has [decimated](https://substack.com/redirect/fdbf6537-972c-4b93-96c3-e29ae59f1d4d?r=1hvr60) news bureaus, reducing the institutional capacity of the press to perform its constitutional function.
And I've repeatedly observed how American journalists have lost their crucial independence, foolishly accepting government narratives about everything from the case for yet another proxy war (Ukraine? China? Iran? Haiti? Take your pick!) to crackdowns on their fellow journalists like Julian Assange. When a publisher faces bipartisan prosecution for exposing government crimes, and other publishers can't be bothered to even write about it, or let people know it's happening, their silence is the sound of a canary singing in a collapsing mine.
#### Can you hear me now?
Millions have shared appropriate alarm at the violent attack endured last Friday by Paul Pelosi, the husband of House Speaker Nancy Pelosi. Most, however, misunderstand both the context and implications of this tragic event.
Corruption with impunity inevitably begets predictable political violence.
First, violent assault is a crime. Full stop. I made that point [explicitly](https://substack.com/redirect/735f1bde-c511-4a4d-aea8-fba4e470c033?r=1hvr60) over the weekend, explaining that while "Outrage towards Nancy Pelosi remains thoroughly appropriate....**Assaulting policymakers --or their families is not. It's a criminal act.**"
[Shahid Buttar for Change @ShahidForChangePolitical violence is a terrible shame, yet also predictable when systems refuse to allow accountability for corruption through peaceful means. Outrage towards Nancy Pelosi remains thoroughly appropriate. Assaulting policymakers--or their families--is not. It's a criminal act. That didn't stop Islamophobes from publicly accusing me of justifying terrorism. They included the editor-in-chief of Mother Jones, an SEIU [labor organizer](https://substack.com/redirect/8c5fb472-1e76-4ca6-acd5-bb9b3229981c?r=1hvr60), a Democratic Party operative who [runs a PR firm](https://substack.com/redirect/17101e71-d893-4c64-ac5c-01d1cf1c158e?r=1hvr60), and a [Vice President of a "grassroots" Democratic Club](https://substack.com/redirect/71691d46-c254-4f75-8cca-34419f7c6c86?r=1hvr60) in southern California. Many others joined in on this latest smear, including a white supremacist who works in San Francisco City Hall on the [staff of Supervisor Rafael Mandelman](https://substack.com/redirect/2164faf5-c1d1-482a-888d-69d78e812bb0?r=1hvr60) despite a documented history of [threatening](https://substack.com/redirect/85614852-a81a-4dd7-af0d-4b82677111c2?r=1hvr60) an Afro-Latina whistleblower with an elected position in the Democratic Party.
Clara Jeffrey, the editor-in-chief of Mother Jones, [insinuated](https://substack.com/redirect/75bdafae-9e63-461d-91ab-9cdedc363ea9?r=1hvr60) that I defended or justified the attack on Paul Pelosi, merely because I offered an explanation familiar to any observer with any awareness of democratic theory: corruption with impunity inevitably begets predictable political violence. SEIU organizer [Doug Jones](https://substack.com/redirect/8c5fb472-1e76-4ca6-acd5-bb9b3229981c?r=1hvr60) and PR flak [Dante Atkins](https://substack.com/redirect/17101e71-d893-4c64-ac5c-01d1cf1c158e?r=1hvr60) each made explicit that Islamophobic accusation.
It requires remarkable foolishness to accuse someone of justifying something they explicitly condemn.
It takes even more to shoot the messenger while ignoring one's own culpability in escalating political violence.
The corruption of our system is painfully obvious to anyone with the independence to observe it. Congress is composed of [insider trading mega-millionaires](https://substack.com/redirect/27f939db-7cb6-44f7-87c6-abe56842aa13?r=1hvr60) who continue to line their pockets, while denying Americans basic human rights enjoyed across the rest of the industrialized world, from healthcare to affordable housing and education.
The leader of House Democrats--who present themselves as the better alternative to the GOP--is the most prolific insider trader among them all, and also among the most wealthy as a direct result. I [explained in ](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd5524b-229f-4ae9-98c6-c6082149eb1c?r=1hvr60)_[Business Insider](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd5524b-229f-4ae9-98c6-c6082149eb1c?r=1hvr60)_ this weekend that "Political violence is never acceptable, but it is entirely predictable when institutions invite and insulate corruption," before noting that Nancy Pelosi runs Congress like a hedge fund manager instead of a guardian of the public interest.
She has never debated a challenger in the 35 years she has been fleecing the public, relying on her sycophants in the press to construct a cult of personality while smearing the only viable opponent to emerge in a generation. And she relies on [ducking debates](https://substack.com/redirect/5f210d36-c3a3-42b9-a590-3a0b8a03d499?r=1hvr60) to get away with enabling a conservative policy agenda on issues from subsidies for fossil fuel companies to bipartisan militarism and impunity for executive-level crimes ranging from human rights violations including torture and mass detention without trial to unconstitutional self-enrichment from public funds.
Many [voices](https://substack.com/redirect/01ea2a25-e8c5-447e-9031-52d8562f4641?r=1hvr60) in the media establishment, from the [New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/9da62b06-cec5-478e-8ed4-26c9e83c8790?r=1hvr60) to [Mother Jones](https://substack.com/redirect/11513bb7-f21c-46f0-9a80-fbbd2e066b20?r=1hvr60), have criticized right wing media for stoking outrage towards Nancy Pelosi. But they ignore their own failures to hold power accountable over the _decades_ that _bipartisan_ corruption has taken increasingly deep root across American institutions.
In other words, global grassroots outrage towards American institutions and figureheads is entirely appropriate--even though violence is not.
Given the appropriateness of this outrage, and the fact that the [institutional corruption that fuels it is growing only worse](https://substack.com/redirect/3d960dfa-b841-4687-b445-72037d3a829e?r=1hvr60), we must sadly anticipate more political violence in the weeks and years ahead. The attack in Pelosi's home was not just a criminal incident, but rather than a dangerous signal of our political system fraying [even further](https://substack.com/redirect/86e5a37e-212d-4990-9e29-099d412499ce?r=1hvr60) at the seams. There will likely be more incidents of preventable violence to come.
Yet critics--especially journalists like Ms. Jeffrey--would rather bury their heads in the sand, shoot the messengers, and ignore their _own_ complicity in the corruption that inevitably invites escalation. Writers who abandoned democracy in a time of relative peace now wring their hands at the political violence invited by their failures, while punching down at immigrant voices who observe what they lack the independence to acknowledge.
As I explained in [response](https://substack.com/redirect/462665b1-0567-499a-b579-8529c69692e2?r=1hvr60) to Jeffrey's Islamophobic and self-serving criticism, "I discovered the hard way that change is not possible...through elections."
Some people accurately observing the bipartisan entrenchment of unapologetic and longstanding corruption will unfortunately do stupid--even criminal--things.
#### Misdirected "solutions"
The only way to stop political violence is to end corruption in politics.
Already, [voices](https://substack.com/redirect/23df1fb5-38d3-459b-b75c-2a4dc9e33325?r=1hvr60) have emerged claiming that the attack on the Pelosis' home justifies rewarding the Capitol Police (despite their [dramatic failure](https://substack.com/redirect/c975f355-e69b-44cb-bf0b-1f5e9dd8370b?r=1hvr60)) with more resources, as well as broader so-called "security" measures like ubiquitous surveillance that ultimately make only powerful people safe. But hurling yet more money at the security state is an idiotic way to respond, akin to treating symptoms of a disease rather than the cause.
The only way to stop political violence is to end corruption in politics, and enable turnover blocked by the careerism of politicians like Pelosi. Only viable pathways for accountability can satisfy the frustration and seething resentment that drives unstable or despairing people to acts of targeted violence.
As long as our leaders continue to fleece the public unapologetically, there will be an endless supply of maniacs willing to do something stupid. [Some](https://substack.com/redirect/86e5a37e-212d-4990-9e29-099d412499ce?r=1hvr60) will be motivated by left wing ideas, [most](https://substack.com/redirect/dd151160-d48a-40b3-a0f3-01fc0f58fe69?r=1hvr60) by right wing ideas, and some (like Paul Pelosi's assailant, David DePape) might [ironically](https://substack.com/redirect/4e350664-b04d-4e1c-bc61-c69bd3c989c5?r=1hvr60) be motivated by [both](https://substack.com/redirect/2cce83ec-c0da-4ca8-be9f-d4fe6b47c0ba?r=1hvr60).
Political violence--or terrorism, as it's more widely described--historically emerges wherever dissent fails to find non-violent mechanisms for expression. The intersecting corruptions of our electoral system, of our judicial and legal system, and of journalism effectively ensure that political violence will continue.
Don't shoot the messenger. **I never said it 's OK.**
Lost on editors like Mothers Jones' Clara Jeffrey is the simple truth: we must expect more of this as long as our leadership class is insulated from any modicum of accountability.
To that extent, journalists who punch down at immigrants who simply explain democratic theory demonstrate not only xenophobic bias against the targets of their mischaracterizations, but also professional ignorance about their own work (or lack thereof) contributes to this race to the bottom.
More than one person has suggested to me that, by being forced out of politics, I might have been saved my own experience of violence. I've taken more than my share of blows from the establishment from which I drew blood, but I'm thankfully still on my feet. Blessings sometimes come in strange disguises.
### Democracy in Brazil
While democracy in America crumbles with every passing day, Brazil appeared to take a sharp turn in the opposite direction this weekend.
The impacts of Lula's return to power cannot possibly be overstated.
#### A victory for climate justice and international peace
On Sunday, a runoff election pit the ecocidal fascist incumbent [welcomed](https://substack.com/redirect/de0bc3b8-fad9-4802-a5cc-b0d50714d8cf?r=1hvr60) to speak at the CIA headquarters under Trump (Jair Bolsonaro) against a left wing populist hero and former Prime Minister (Lula Da Silva). While the two emerged at the top of a crowded field of candidates in an early round of voting, neither broke the 50% threshold necessary to win, prompting the runoff in which Lula appeared to win with a comfortable margin.
The impacts of Lula's return to power cannot possibly be overstated.
First, he is poised to challenge the American hegemony that Bolsonaro not only accepted but also helped facilitate. Rather than emerge as a competing imperial pole, however, Brazil is poised to do what it did many years ago: lead a global non-aligned movement among states rejecting the "clash of civilizations" between competing superpowers.
At the same time, Brazil restoring a popular head of state deposed by a former military officer--at the same time that America descends into political demagoguery--suggests that democracy may survive the failures across Washington. While democracy wanes in the North, it waxes in the South.
Rather than fall within the umbrella of Pax Americana--the so-called "peace" enjoyed under an empire that steals indigenous land, murders people of color, and plunders irreplaceable natural resources--Brazil under Lula's leadership could offer a beacon of hope to other countries looking for ways to establish diplomatic independence from the American axis.
More concretely, Lula is poised to help stop Bolsonaro's [acceleration](https://substack.com/redirect/54df8006-fb03-4636-ba88-c4e89687968c?r=1hvr60) of ecocide in the Amazon. Deforestation is not the only ingredient in the soup of climate chaos, but it's a big one. And while it was a problem well before Bolsonaro took office, it accelerated under his regime at the same time as scientists around the world have issued [increasingly dire warnings](https://substack.com/redirect/ef341a70-f107-41eb-9036-97a30fe6b30b?r=1hvr60) about the rates at which greenhouses gases are accumulating and global carbon sequestration capacity is diminishing.
As mass extinction continues, entire ecosystems are collapsing--almost as fast as antarctic ice shelves.
Climate nihilism, anxiety, and depression are a scourge impacting many generations of Americans, especially young people who feel betrayed by older generations and the institutions they have allowed to run all of humanity off a cliff. Those who struggle with any of those understandable feelings might find some hope in new stewardship for the Amazon.
Lula's victory in Brazil is, for once, a global event worthy of celebration.
#### Not out of the woods yet
As Americans have come to discover all too clearly, aspiring despots defeated at the polls sometimes decline to respect the peaceful transition of power. While this weekend's election bodes well for the future, Lula is not scheduled to be seated until January.
Given how many of [Trump's cues Bolsonaro has followed](https://substack.com/redirect/3813e018-a030-450c-8cd4-7e7d972768fb?r=1hvr60) to this point, I would hardly be surprised by him attempting to subvert the certification of the Brazilian vote in one way or another. In fact, I wouldn't be terribly surprised if the CIA were to play a role (again), given that the Agency welcomed him to speak at its headquarters not long after he came to power in the first place.
### Connecting the dots between MLK's "intersecting evils" and the "chickens coming home to roost" observed by Malcolm X
When democratic institutions fail (as they have across the U.S.) political violence becomes sadly predictable.
The voices of immigrants in diaspora are especially relevant here, because many of our native countries have gone through this pattern--but American journalists are so ignorant and co-opted that they conflate explanation with justification, reinforcing Islamophobia by tone policing and blaming activists who apparently understand democratic theory better than they do.
MLK [bemoaned](https://substack.com/redirect/334767f1-d065-4a41-bc65-f1b5a9228a33?r=1hvr60) the complicity of "the white Moderate" in injustice. As Brother Malcolm X noted at a different time, "[chickens...come home to roost](https://substack.com/redirect/27cffe6c-1a42-405a-bab5-26dbfd25c858?r=1hvr60)."
I find great solace in their voices today.
Few places in the world today demonstrate more clearly than Brazil how the "intersecting evils" that Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. described work together to undermine human rights. Paid subscribers can access video of a short speech I delivered at the Youth Climate Strike in San Jose in 2019 describing how MLK's analysis relates to the climate catastrophe.
If American journalists ever mustered the independence to report on this kind of independent analysis, we might have had a chance to hold establishment corruption accountable through peaceful means. Even those who hold MLK's vision in disdain might have favored that outcome had they realized how their defense of corruption would eventually invite the collapse of democracy in America...

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day. ** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T198ef68a-0570-4cc8-85db-cb8530c04509/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 7 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Can you rush a donation right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T02a25544-4fa8-4b61-b1a8-5aac86b9534d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A $22 donation = FIVE new voters registered! $44 and they can register TEN NEW VOTERS! Click the button below to chip in and join our fight ⇩⇩**

1. Marco Rubio has been outraised Five Quarters in a row.

5. His opponent has spent over $40 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can't keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

******[DEFEND MARCO RUBIO >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778220:6cHCBsGNY:m:1:3331703221:3C8224A99F5CF4C107DCF164851066EF:r)******

[**If you can spare $25, $35, or even $50, it will make all the difference in this tied race.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778221:6cHCBsGNY:m:1:3331703221:3C8224A99F5CF4C107DCF164851066EF:r)[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778220:6cHCBsGNY:m:1:3331703221:3C8224A99F5CF4C107DCF164851066EF:r)

Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

You have the power to decide what happens next. _You have two choices:_
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. [**We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778220:6cHCBsGNY:m:1:3331703221:3C8224A99F5CF4C107DCF164851066EF:r)

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson

clean_body: | | Friend, It’s the final day of the last deadline of this election and the pressure is on. We’re just $5,729 dollars short of our monthly goal going into today. With just seven days left until the election, it’s crucial we raise enough funds to get over the top. Right now, we’re working extremely hard to ensure we can meet our goal by midnight tonight. I’ve been hitting the pavement from sunrise to sunset, and my team is doing the same from where they are. We have had a strong showing to date, but we still have work to do in this final week. We’ve been receiving incredible shows of support from all of you across Vermont! We know we can win next week, but we need to land this plane strong. My team is not the only one pushing hard right now. I am sure the Vermont GOP is pushing just as hard, and they have the fundraising advantage of corporate backing. We must be competitive and diligent against our deep pocketed opponents with our grassroots fundraising. Peter ? this is bad ? really bad. We've just received word that a major right-wing Super PAC has dropped $5 million into the Arizona Senate race, where Senator Mark Kelly is up against venture capital executive Blake Masters.

Mark Kelly is an environmental champion who just helped secure the most significant climate investment in history. Blake Masters is a climate change denier who's backed by white supremacists.

[**Democrat Congresswoman violated Florida election laws in front of news outlets, according to complaint filed with Supervisor of Elections**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=20a76c4acf&e=00028e5542)
TAMPA, Fla. - Congresswoman Kathy Castor (D-FL) illegally entered an early voting polling place in Tampa last week and was subsequently removed, according to a report filed with the Hillsborough County Supervisor of Elections.The reported incident took place at Jan Kaminis Platt Regional Library in South Tampa. Castor, who was not there to cast a vote, reportedly entered through the exit with a news media crew embedded with her campaign.Castor violated the 150-foot exclusion zone, which prohibits candidates and campaign officials from campaigning at polling locations and is a violation of the law. Additionally, walking in through the exit is also in itself a violation of Florida election laws.According to the complaints, she was present at the polling place for a campaign media opportunity on the first day of early voting, which aired later that day on local news outlets.The polling center clerk, Jackie Weaver, reportedly intercepted Castor inside the polling station and escorted Castor and the news media outside, following the infraction.According to the report, Weaver reported the alleged criminal activity to the Supervisor of Elections.Castor was reportedly aware that she was in violation of the law, but simply did not care.“We’ve seen this time and time again from Democrats like Castor, who believe they are above the law. This is nothing new. Throughout all of COVID, Democrats constantly instituted one set of standards for the public like requiring masks and banning indoor eating, and then were photographed in violation of the law. I have no doubt that very little, if anything, will happen as a result of the infraction. Unfortunately, the system is too broken to actually hold her accountable,” said James Judge, Castor’s opponent as the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. “Shockingly, this entire incident was reportedly documented by the media, and they reported nothing about it. This is precisely why I am running for office, to get rid of the double standards and hold the media and career politicians accountable for everything which they are responsible.”In addition to the violations of Florida election laws, it is also questionable whether some local media outlets violated FCC regulations by covering only Castor’s campaign activities that day. By law, broadcast media outlets are required to provide equal airtime for opposing candidates. While one media outlet did interview Judge in accordance with the equal airtime law, multiple media outlets were reportedly present for Castor’s campaign event outside of the polling location.Judge squares off with Castor in the Nov. 8 general election.Judge has also been endorsed by several additional prominent figures and organizations.They include:· Senator Rick Scott (R-FL)· Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL)· Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)· Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL) retired· Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard· Florida Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri· The Tampa Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats (retired)· Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast· The Community Patriots Tampa· Republican strategist Roger Stone· Chris Chambers, former Congressional candidate and community leader· Matt Becker, small business owner, former SBA White House Deputy Chief, and former Congressional Candidate**About James Judge:
** Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, is the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom while serving in the U.S. Coast Guard. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011 under General David Petraeus. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the National Rifle Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Tampa Propeller Club and the Coastal Conservation Association. The Judges are also long-time, active members of Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Uniting police with Black communities
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778078:6FbXBsGNv:m:1:3331421248:BCE595C07855391688B4DFEC7CBD4D3F:r)

Hello Peter,

The Left wants the next generation of Black Americans to self-destruct. They have set out to destroy our families, defund the police, and leave our communities vulnerable.

And if the Left succeeds, the next generation will have no family to support them and become victims of crime in their own neighborhoods.

I saw a video of a group of Black teens DESTROYING a local store in their own community. This was where their parents and grandparents shopped, and these children destroyed it for no reason -- _**just because they were bored.**_

My name is Brandom Tatum, an ex-police officer and co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation.

**BLEXIT is extending an opportunity for you to get involved and empower Black communities by opening pro-police dialogues.**

Peter, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 in the next 48 hours to support our work to build strong communities and stop the over-incarceration of minorities among the next generation.

[_**Can you join us in our mission by sending a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778078:6FbXBsGNv:m:1:3331421248:BCE595C07855391688B4DFEC7CBD4D3F:r)

The only limits we face come from the person in the mirror.
* Not from our skin color.
* Not from where we grow up.
* Not from a broken family.

This is a deeply personal topic to me. I served in the Tucson Police Department as a SWAT operator, field training officer, general instructor, and Public Information Officer.

**I know how important it is to create relationships between police officers and these communities.**

Black communities must end the victimhood mentality that the media and other organizations force on us. It's why BLEXIT stresses the importance of education, family, the presence of a father in the home, and the support of a strong community to _**avoid**_ incarceration.

[_**Support BLEXIT 's mission to reach urban communities >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778078:6FbXBsGNv:m:1:3331421248:BCE595C07855391688B4DFEC7CBD4D3F:r)

When I co-founded BLEXIT, I promised myself that we would not be just a "think tank" but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank."

We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing and going places that are often ignored, like Detroit and Baltimore.

We believe there are five primary program areas in which BLEXIT Foundation must engage to change the narrative surrounding America's minority communities.
* Advocating for School Choice.
* Promoting a pro-police criminal justice reform.
* Championing entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
* Developing history programs that will inspire minority children.
* Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

All while championing our values of faith, family, and freedom to empower Black and minority communities.

Peter, can you help BLEXIT build bridges in these communities by helping me reach my goal of raising $24,000 in the next 48 hours? **Click below to send your gift. **

subject: It was a great birthday.....
body:

**NYDIA STONE**
---
| Dear Friend, First let me tell you that last week I had my cancer pet- scan and I have now been _free for 18 months of the stage 4 cancer_ I was diagnosed with right after President Trump pardoned my husband Roger in the Russian Collusion hoax. In fact, I celebrated my birthday last week! It was a glorious day. I feel blessed to be alive. This is proof of the healing power of Jesus Christ! I want to thank you for your prayers and support in what has been a very difficult time for our family. I wish I could tell you that the pressure and stress on us was over but that is not the case. Despite the fact that Roger was not on Ellipse, did not march to the Capitol and was not at the Capitol, the January 6 Committee has falsely insisted that Roger MUST have been involved in some illegal activity on January 6 despite any evidence whatsoever! They even produced some totally manipulated videos to drag Roger's name through the mud again! Ten days ago the January 6th Committee issued a subpoena for testimony and communications between President Trump and Roger from November 3, 2020 up until now, despite the fact that neither President Trump or my husband has done anything wrong! Will this nightmare and the harassment never end? _We are already drowning in legal bills fighting the ELEVEN totally baseless harassment civil lawsuits_ filed against Roger by crazy and hateful liberals still bitter that President Trump pardoned Roger. Now this will cost us even more in lawyer's bills! There is not a single month in which the total of the bills from our lawyers, our modest living expenses and my uninsured medical expenses are not more than Roger makes writing, speaking and doing his daily podcast at Stonezone.Live at 5 pm Eastern each day. I really don't know how Roger finds the strength and energy to keep fighting but I do know the Lord has blessed us both. I am sorry to have to ask for your help again but I must. Now more than ever we need your help. Please pray for us and send a contribution to Roger's Legal Defense Fund today by going [HERE](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=oq6x1vh1z0k3oto9wy&linkid=0&link=02bd2989386c49e8984a8bf38042f877)? God Bless You. Mrs. Roger Stone PS- If you are uncomfortable sending your credit card information over the internet you can make a check payable to "Stone Defense Fund" and mailing it to 1007 North Federal Highway, #405, Fort Lauderdale, Florida 33304. PPS- Have a great Thanksgiving. In this last week before the election, my team and I are truly giving it our all. Because this isn’t just about winning or losing, it’s about protecting this district and our country from a radical MAGA agenda that is anti-woman, anti-democracy, anti-worker, and anti-LGBTQ+ rights. It is so important to always remember your roots and where you came from. I grew up in this community, and it was my community that nominated me to run for Congress. Juntos, we brought this campaign from a heated primary with mostly local attention, through an incredibly tight runoff, to where we are today: a race with national attention and support from high-profile Democrats like Beto O’Rourke and Bernie Sanders. Even when other national Democratic groups turned their backs on us, we kept fighting and building the momentum that has brought this race to the dead heat it is in today. body:
| | | Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises—internal and external—that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.

From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

Today, challenges to our republic are rampant. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in states like New Hampshire.

Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact _all_ Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.

Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.

Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just 7 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote across the country.

**[_So I'm asking you now: will you help meet this moment by splitting a donation between Maggie Hassan and the DSCC today?_](https://go.dscc.org/go/4728?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221101-KenBurns-BurnsSignedHassanTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221101-KenBurns-BurnsSignedHassanTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=8295%2E9716520%2EQbY0Sd)**

Thank you,
Ken

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: too close to home
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Country First
body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- I'm sure you were just as shocked by the horrific attack on Speaker Pelosi's husband Paul as I was. The assailant was looking for Nancy, tried to zip-tie Paul, and then bashed his head with a hammer. This was clearly an _assassination attempt._ But I'm also sad this violence isn't more surprising -- just as I wasn't surprised by January 6th. This is what happens when we're taught that those who disagree with us are existential threats to our survival; when we label our own tribe good and the other evil; when we fail to call out the bad behavior of our own "side" out of loyalty or denial. The attack on Nancy's family hits too close to home. My own family receives a near constant stream of death threats. Standing for truth and defending democracy have labeled me a "traitor" (although they often spell it "trader") for many in my tribe. And, of course, the unhinged always take it a step too far. But I swore an Oath -- when I signed up to serve our nation in the military and in Congress -- and I'm not going to abandon it now. That's why Country First is working overtime across the country to educate and mobilize voters in support of our [Defenders of Democracy](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=2) endorsement slate. Last week, I hosted an awesome #Vote4Democracy Rally with some big guests that was seen by over 20,000 Americans! [](https://www.country1st.com/rally_replay?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=3) [**> > Watch the Replay Here**](https://www.country1st.com/rally_replay?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=4) I hope you'll join me in defending democracy yourself, with your [time](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=5) or [support](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=6), and will help bring new people into our movement with your unique link: https://www.country1st.com/opportunity?recruiter_id=91510 But no matter what happens a week from today, there's going to be plenty of work to do. There's a good chance Donald Trump will run for President; there's a good chance Republicans in Congress will double-down on him; there's a good chance we'll feel more divided and less hopeful than ever... _if_ we had to wait two years to channel our energy and efforts again. And that's where this movement and the reasonable majority we're attracting will play a critical role in correcting course and casting a vision for what our country can be when we focus on standing for truth, solving problems, and mending division. We will defend democracy; we will save this country. After all, what other choice do we have? Thank God we still have the chance to choose. Country First, Adam | [](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=dJRvzSZalRTZC0Qwm1nuRI-rk5pyYwx3MVaObW7hk1A&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=7 "Wear Your Values") [Wear Your Values](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=dJRvzSZalRTZC0Qwm1nuRI-rk5pyYwx3MVaObW7hk1A&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paulpelosi_nd&n=7)

#
Derek, we know we’ve emailed you a bunch lately but we’re once again asking for your support. 🙏
We set a goal last week to raise $5 million by midnight on Halloween. And it looks like folks may have gotten spooked because we didn’t reach our goal last night. 😔
Seriously, goals like this aren’t set arbitrarily — our finance team helped us set this goal to ensure we have all the funds we need over these next seven days until Election Day.
In other words, our last October goal was precisely what we needed to raise to stay on track to fight back against Oz’s attacks + fund our entire GOTV organizing plan until the election. So we're asking for your support again hoping this team can help make up the difference.
**[We need just three more people from 18326 to contribute before midnight tonight, so we have to ask: Derek, will you chip in $5 or more right now so we can get back on track and reach our goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221101-3?refcode=em20221101-7999&refcode2=7999_434096_CJZFa8&akid=7999%2E434096%2ECJZFa8)**

name: John Lira
subject: We officially blew the engine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Texans for John Lira
body:
Well, we officially blew the engine in my car. (No, seriously!)

After nearly a year of campaigning across TX-23, the engine in my car FINALLY burned out.

You don’t have to live in TX-23 to appreciate just how big this district really is.

Can you rush a contribution right now so we can ensure our volunteers have the resources they need as they travel across the district to help us unseat Tony Gonzales? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221101Engine_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=5]

For the last leg of my campaign, I put 23,000 miles on my mother’s car after mine finally bit the dust and I borrowed hers.

But one thing I learned while I was in the Marines — sometimes you just have to improvise.

And please keep in mind that when you’re driving across TX-23, sometimes it can feel like you’re driving on a treadmill! But I’ve really enjoyed seeing the beauty that this district has to offer.

The #1 thing you need to know is this: Our volunteers are out driving across the district nearly every day, which is why your support helps us keep them going with gas cards, snacks, bottles of water and more.

So today, I’m humbly asking:

Will you please make a $5 donation or more toward our people-powered movement? This is our chance to flip this seat blue and get right-wing extremist Tony Gonzales out of Washington. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221101Engine_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=5]

Thanks for all you do.

John

Friend,
A week from today, polls will close. We won’t be able to do anything more to convince Minnesotans to vote for DFLers. As we wait for election results next week, I want to feel like we’ve put everything we can into this election. Seven days may not seem like a lot of time, but with DFLers like you supporting us we can get a lot done. I need you to do a few things to make sure we protect our House DFL majority, friend.
First, if you haven’t already voted, make a plan to do so. Second, volunteer! There are lots of opportunities for you to talk to potential voters between now and Election Day, and talking directly to Minnesota voters makes a huge difference. Lastly, we still need to fund our campaign through Election Day. Our campaign staff has been working tirelessly to elect House DFLers, will you make a contribution to the campaign today to show them your support?
Make a plan to vote [https://www.sos.state.mn.us/elections-voting/]
Volunteer [https://www.mobilize.us/minnesotahousedfl/]
Make a contribution [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hdfl-nov22?refcode=110122]
This last week is going to be over before we know it, friend. Our House DFL campaign is going to keep running through the finish line because we know what’s at stake: reproductive freedom, strengthening public education, protecting our democracy, and more. I’m committed to ensuring we protect the House DFL majority so we can keep building a Minnesota that works better for everyone.
Thank you for your support.
Melissa Hortman

body:
Will you help me continue it?

| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778309:JKQ19sGNN:m:1:3365131770:9A7D5A491210C3049B9F723BFF616CBC:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778309:JKQ19sGNN:m:1:3365131770:9A7D5A491210C3049B9F723BFF616CBC:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778309:JKQ19sGNN:m:1:3365131770:9A7D5A491210C3049B9F723BFF616CBC:r "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778309:JKQ19sGNN:m:1:3365131770:9A7D5A491210C3049B9F723BFF616CBC:r "Adam 3")

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61778309:JKQ19sGNN:m:1:3365131770:9A7D5A491210C3049B9F723BFF616CBC:r "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

Adam Laxalt

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=afe4e24450&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

| **RX OUTREACH EXPANDS ELIGIBILITY **
Below is a memo from a trusted non-profit:

As a non-profit, mail-order pharmacy, Rx Outreach is uniquely positioned to help stop the spread of COVID-19 for people who are quarantined and those who may be afraid to travel outside of their homes to the clinic or pharmacy.

Rx Outreach lifted its income guidelines during this crisis so that **anyone, regardless of income, can participate in their program.**

Rx Outreach medication prices are generally 70-80% below retail and are transparent. Shipping is free.

Eli Lilly and Company has introduced a program to purchase Basaglar insulin at significant cost savings. #

Friends —
Mark reached out this morning to let you know that we’ve set our final goal of the campaign: **$1 million by Election Day.**
We’re hoping you can lend a hand before then, because this final goal is critical.
Just days after Peter Thiel and his Super PAC committed another $8.5 million to the race, Cook Political Report just changed our race rating from Lean Democrat back to TOSS UP. Numerous polls have Mark TIED with Blake Masters.
Election Day is a week away and we haven’t raised as much today as we’d hoped to hit our goals.
Now the way we see it, we have two ways to catch up:
1. We either need more people to chip in.
2. Or we need everyone who donates to give just a little bit more than usual.

Most first-time contributors chip in $10. If you would consider making your first contribution $15 instead, it’ll help us make up for lost ground. What do you say?

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: what I learned from my high school Shakespeare class
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1247%2E5257348%2EIAxnDo ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

I was moving some boxes of old junk into the attic recently and found a
couple of scrapbooks. One of them included a photo that I just had to
share with you from high school.

This photo is of me after winning a competition for a speech on America’s
free enterprise system, believe it or not. (Leave it to a high school
student to opine on the economy whose only relevant experience was working
in a restaurant and his father’s lumber yard.) The envelope contained a
check for first prize — it was a hundred dollars. That was a lot of money
back then. It still is. Just take a look:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2022_abs_em.YLWDKC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20221101_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1004&akid=1247%2E5257348%2EIAxnDo ]Old photo of Adam Schiff during his high school debate years

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=nov2022_abs_em.lEaqBw&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20221101_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1005&akid=1247%2E5257348%2EIAxnDo ]Before I go on, and I realize this is a different type of email than
you’re getting from most campaigns right now, can you pitch in $10 to help
fuel my fight to protect our democracy and our House and Senate
Majorities?

When I was 11 years old, my dad moved our family from Scottsdale, Arizona
to the San Francisco Bay Area. I started in a new middle school before
attending Monte Vista High School in Danville.

I played on the soccer team and had several wonderful teachers who really
made a mark on me. There was Mr. Morrison, who taught contemporary world
problems; Ms. Shackleford, my calculus teacher; and Mr. Morrison, who
taught physiology and had us dissecting fetal pigs — I can still smell the
formaldehyde. Ugh.

But the two teachers who left the biggest mark on me were Ms. Abbott, my
Shakespeare teacher, and Al Gentile, my speech coach.

Ms. Abbott took our class up to Oregon each summer for the Shakespeare
festival, but it was Mr. Gentile who taught us the art of public speaking.
That was the after-school activity that really got me going and I was soon
competing in speech tournaments. At first, I wasn’t very good, scoring 5s
at tournaments which was, well, the lowest score you could get. I did
dramatic interpretation — Twelve Angry Men and Inherit the Wind were a
couple of favorites — I loved those plays but ... they didn’t love me.

Then I switched to Original Oratory and things started to change. In “OO”
you could write your own material, craft a speech on a topic of your own
choice, and that made all the difference. Hence the picture before you
now.

Although speaking before others did not come naturally to me, I worked
hard at it, reading great speeches from Lincoln and Frederick Douglass,
and listening to recordings of Robert Kennedy, Martin Luther King, Jr.,
Winston Churchill, John F. Kennedy, and more.

I couldn’t get enough. From the tinny phonograph in my bedroom came these
wonderful if scratchy recordings of the greatest speakers of the modern
era. It was mesmerizing. And from my brother’s room next door, the sounds
of Richard Burton, Laurence Olivier and other greats performing
Shakespeare.

To this day, I draw on them for inspiration when I’m writing a speech. For
my core thesis, I gather the elements that I want to weave together from
history, the law or Constitution, or, in the case of an investigation, the
key pieces of evidence.

Perhaps most important, I try to outline the speech I want to give in my
head, without the tyranny of a blank page in front of me. Only when I have
a good idea of how I want to structure the piece do I sit down to write.
Ideally in a comfy chair by the fire.

During the first impeachment trial of President Trump, I would take notes
on the key elements that I thought should be incorporated into a closing
argument for the day. If I didn’t have time to write the closing, I would
put numbers next to each of those bullets to put them in some logical
order that told a story. And then I would improvise.

But occasionally, I had a whole evening to write a closing argument, and
there, I waited until my thoughts coalesced around the theme and its most
logical order before putting pen to paper, or more accurately — fingers to
iPad!

Some things never change. But the lessons from those early years — and
from those wonderful teachers — have stayed with me:

The need to speak plainly, but not dumb down your words. The need to
communicate in a way that draws on the inherent beauty of our language,
and our higher aspirations and ideals. And the need to appeal to the best
in human nature, not the worst.

I hope these lessons have helped me be a more effective advocate for our
democracy. My parents and teachers taught me that certain very basic
values really mattered. That truth matters, that decency matters, and that
our democracy matters. And it’s up to each one of us to use the skills we
have to fight for them.

And it’s why I’m asking you today:
